I didn’t think Oz could get worse...but he proved me wrong.

Last weekend, I sent you an email about how Dr. Oz is like a literal movie villain.
At the time, I didn’t think he could get much worse... and then:
❌ The Washington Post exposed him for making million$ by hawking diets, phony cancer treatments, and “miracle” (scam) cures on TV.
❌ Oz loaned his campaign a whopping $7 million from his personal fortune to try and overpower our grassroots campaign.
❌ Oh, and we found out Oz actually murdered puppies.
Yikes. Not to mention he owns a ridiculous amount of properties, called *all* abortion “murder,” and is running for Senate in a state he doesn’t even live in...
At this point, Dr. Oz is _literally_ a villain.
**[It’s clear Oz shouldn’t be anywhere near the Senate, but a new poll showed us statistically _tied_!! body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "I will always stand up for our
heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570290:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570291:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570291:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570291:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570292:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570293:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61570293:J1nl4SVN1:m:1:3317145305:2083D182CA09E53AECB597608FEE5DA0:r "Step up
now!")**_

Fetterman is dangerous

| Peter,

It all comes down to me.

The Senate. America. Our children's future. Everything is riding on my race against John Fetterman.

I'm not afraid of this fight. I would never have jumped in this race if I wasn't ready for such a huge responsibility.

But I can't afford to be shy with so much on the line. So I'll just come right out and ask: **_[Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563645:J-5AUSVN8:m:1:3334294963:FE0F0F63E058630FE397847A9B6ECB02:r "Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?")_**

John Fetterman simply cannot be allowed in Congress. His priorities will crush American families and put our communities at risk.

**He has pushed to free convicted murderers amid a massive spike in violent crime, and he 's committed to growing America's bloated and expensive bureaucracy.**

Fetterman's agenda will devastate our country, Peter. But he's still polling just ahead of me, thanks to his MASSIVE cash advantage.

We're now less than **30 days** from Election Day and this race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive in history. **My opponent raised over $5.5 MILLION in August from fundraising emails just like this.**

_**[That's why I'm coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my campaign and wash away Fetterman's cash advantage.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563645:J-5AUSVN8:m:1:3334294963:FE0F0F63E058630FE397847A9B6ECB02:r "That’s why
I’m coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my campaign and wash away Fetterman’s cash
advantage.")**_

I'm ready to face down my opponent's massive political machine by myself, Peter. But it would really help if I had you on my side.

Thank you for your generous support,
Dr. Oz

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61572192:61ltTqVMN:m:1:3299561967:0F128BE5BD33081CCE8B900EA61F3463:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61572192:61ltTqVMN:m:1:3299561967:0F128BE5BD33081CCE8B900EA61F3463:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61572192:61ltTqVMN:m:1:3299561967:0F128BE5BD33081CCE8B900EA61F3463:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61572192:61ltTqVMN:m:1:3299561967:0F128BE5BD33081CCE8B900EA61F3463:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61572192:61ltTqVMN:m:1:3299561967:0F128BE5BD33081CCE8B900EA61F3463:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61572192:61ltTqVMN:m:1:3299561967:0F128BE5BD33081CCE8B900EA61F3463:r "Washingtonians
need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61572192:61ltTqVMN:m:1:3299561967:0F128BE5BD33081CCE8B900EA61F3463:r "So please, can you chip in just a

Tiffany Smiley

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

name: Jacky Rosen
subject: about my decision to run for Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
I'm proud that my faith tradition helps guide my service to Nevada and our country.
| | |
---
Friend,

Want to know how I first got into politics? I was recruited to run for Congress while serving as the president of my synagogue.

Looking back, although it seems a bit unconventional, it's incredibly fitting that leading Nevada’s largest synagogue was my entry point to public service. My Jewish faith and values are at the very core of so much of my work in the Senate today. In fact, my decision to run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
**Now, as both the third Jewish woman senator in U.S. history and the only former synagogue president in the Senate, I'm proud that my faith tradition helps guide my service to Nevada and our country.**

I firmly believe that if everybody stands firm and does their part to help better this world, we can move mountains to make positive change happen. **As we face everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on abortion rights and threats to tear down our very democracy, there's never been a more crucial time for us to come together, roll up our sleeves, and make a difference.**
**[So if the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you – if you're with me in the fight to make real progress for our country – I hope you'll chip in $5 or more today to help me continue this critical work in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52297280/371870929/610767770?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2080-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OWIyMmI3Zi05NDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VpsThO2JfqlGbXY1sRnch2b-hi1ctyDkI-plRn1lsog=)**
Whenever we have the opportunity to stand up and make progress for the people we love and for our communities, we should. Thank you so much for helping me do that today.

Jacky

"I believe it falls on someone like me to warn people... clearly... and without distraction...
I can do this now because I'm too rich to care about money... and too old to care about what anyone says about me."

The good news is... we’re just getting started.

My opponent’s extreme agenda and admiration of Soros-backed policies only fuel my resolve to fight woke tyranny and Keep Florida Free.

Happy Indigenous Peoples' Day, friend! **Today is a day meant for celebrating the strength, history, and resiliency of Indigenous Peoples all across North America** , as well as honoring their contributions throughout history and standing in solidarity with those continuing to fight for their rights to this day. It is an opportunity for us to reflect on the multifaceted history that our Native American communities have had here in New Mexico, and to find ways to continue to honor Tribes. But you won’t find “Indigenous Peoples’ Day” on a calendar, because it’s still not recognized as a federal holiday. We’ve got to change that, and here in New Mexico, we already have. In 2019, Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham officially declared the second Monday of October Indigenous Peoples’ Day, in which we celebrate the culture and traditions of New Mexico’s first citizens. Native American nations such as Zuni, Laguna, Acoma and Isleta Pueblos, as well as the Diné (Navajo Nation), the Mescalero Apache, Fort Sill Apache, and the Piro-Manso-Tiwa, among other New Mexico Tribal communities, enrich our district and contribute so much. While President Biden acknowledged Indigenous Peoples’ Day as a national holiday alongside Columbus Day this time last year, it still isn’t an official federal holiday — and it’s time we change that. **My friend Senator Martin Heinrich has introduced a bill in the U.S. Senate to replace Columbus Day with Indigenous Peoples’ Day at the federal level, and I fully support it.** **[Join me in supporting this bill and calling on our leaders in Washington to finally pass it: add your name to support making Indigenous Peoples’ Day a federal holiday now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52309553/371919713/-1677968852?refcode=fl_em_pt_20221010ipd_gv_od90ds_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDllMDFmMy1hYzQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oEdRh1vjHu5P93XApMX8_9fG8nhmTK9mJyKZZfJsGMY=&emci=c05651fc-ab48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=c09e01f3-ac48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=4482565)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52309554/371919714/-1677968852?refcode=fl_em_pt_20221010ipd_gv_od90ds_xx_btn&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMDllMDFmMy1hYzQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oEdRh1vjHu5P93XApMX8_9fG8nhmTK9mJyKZZfJsGMY=&emci=c05651fc-ab48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=c09e01f3-ac48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=4482565)

body:
Time to unseat one of the worst Republicans.

| | | | | _Peter,_ I’m Paul Begala. I’m a Democratic campaign strategist, former counselor to President Bill Clinton, and I’ve dedicated my career to electing Democrats up and down the ballot.

So today, I’m reaching out about one of the most important races this cycle: **We have the incredible opportunity to unseat one of the worst Republicans in the US House, Rep. Chabot, and replace him with a champion for families.**

Our slim House majority is on the line in just a few weeks, and I know Greg Landsman is the leader we need to retire Chabot and protect our democracy, fundamental rights, and so much more.

**[Will you join me in supporting Greg Landsman’s people-powered campaign for this Ohio toss-up seat by chipping in $3 today? We need all hands on deck to get this done »](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdb861208-3943-441f-b53a-e114d31f58d9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| Peter, I won’t mince words here.

It’s imperative that we elect strong Democrats like Greg Landsman this year.

**Far-right Republicans, just like his opponent Chabot, want nothing more than to win the House majority and impose their extreme views on all of us.**

_They’ve made it clear:_ They want a national ban on abortion. They want to stack the Supreme Court with even more extremists. And they want to tear down the fundamental core of our democracy.

We can’t get complacent, Peter. We’ve fought for too hard and for too long to let that happen.

This week, we are still asking you to sign up as poll workers and watchers, sign up to volunteer for Get Out The Vote activities, and sign a petition to the White House demanding they stop firing heroes like Zach Loesch, the Coast Guard member who was personally thanked by Biden for his “heroic work” during Hurricane Ian rescue efforts. We’ve also updated our Reopen the Keystone Pipeline AlignAct campaign to include the recent news about OPEC, and new requests for Congress when you call. This campaign has been changed quite a bit, so even if you completed this one before, please do it again, using the updates.

| | |
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
**URGENT: Election Workers Still Needed!** If you haven’t already, now is the time to find out more about being a poll worker or poll watcher, before the deadlines hit! Each state has different deadlines, so see below about how to find out about your state’s deadlines and process to sign up! **First,**[**fill out our form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to let us know you are interested. This way, we can reach out to you to answer questions, or help you figure things out. **Second, go the** [**U.S. Election Assistance Commission’s website**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIyODMtZDRkYjZhZjUzZDFmNGRkZjhjZTIyODZiMTkyNmIwNzYiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMiIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmVhYy5nb3YvaGVscC1hbWVyaWNhLXZvdGU_bWlkPTQ1OTAzJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/YRIrKQJKGk9DgSMSxP3qnw) to find out how to sign up in your state. Scroll down to the **Poll Worker Recruitment Lookup Tool** and select your state, and follow the instructions listed there.
---
|
---
**Poll Workers** When we say "poll workers," we mean the people who check voters into the precinct location to vote, hands the voter their ballot or card for the ballot marking device (touch screen computer with ballot), tells the voter where to deposit the ballot in the ballot box, and closes the precinct location after voting is over. Your state may call this position one of the following titles: poll worker, election official, judge of elections, inspector of elections, judge, inspector, or some other similar title. These "poll workers" are generally hired at county level by the permanent employees who administer the elections and maintain voter rolls. Those permanent employees may hold one of the following titles: election supervisor, election board, board of elections, board of commissioners, county supervisors, county judges, etc. The titles vary from state to state. Generally speaking, if you want to work the election on Election Day or during early voting and be paid to work, you will need to reach out the county employee responsible for hiring those poll workers. **Poll Watchers** A poll watcher is the person who is in the voting precinct while voters vote, silently watching and observing the election process. If the poll watcher sees irregularities, the poll watcher will report those irregularities to the entity (i.e., county political party) that assigned the poll watcher position based on the training received by that entity (county political party).
---
|
---
| | Americans have reason to be angry as they head to the polls. They [have lost an average of $4,200 in annual income](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) since the Democrats assumed control of the legislative and executive branches of government, a recent Heritage Foundation study found. And in 2022, inflation will cost American families $5,520, experts project. Grocery prices have far outpaced the already-high overall inflation rate, new federal [data](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTAzJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/h_90qsRMLaa470JA3T5NRw) shows, explaining why 68.3% of likely voters say that the “increase in the price of groceries is [impacting their motivation](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to vote in the 2022 election.” Significantly, 64.1% of likely independent voters agree that higher grocery prices are impacting their motivation to vote, according to a Convention of States/Trafalgar Group [poll](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.). According to a new [Ipsos poll](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-O-A), 43% of Americans fear that inflation will continue to soar under Democrat rule if the party controls Congress. Only 24 percent say the same of Republicans.
---
| | |
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
**URGENT: Get Out The Vote Volunteer Sign-up!** Right up there in importance with securing our elections is getting out the vote! The more legitimate votes there are, the harder it is for anyone trying to cheat to be able to get away with it. Additionally, we 100% need a new Congress and are more likely to get one if everyone helps to turn out the vote! [**Please fill out this form**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to let us know which type of activities you’d be interested in doing for Get Out The Vote!
---
[VOLUNTEER](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-vKkymbQ)
---
|
---
| | Government sponsored censorship is [rearing its head again](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._sgyYhC4D-ag), this time leading up to the 2022 midterm elections. The Election Integrity Partnership (EIP), a federal agency-backed censorship machine, was established in 2020 to alter thousands of web URLs and millions of social media posts 100 days before the general election, raising concerns about [election meddling schemes](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-mFYnqw). Comprised of four private entities and led by Stanford and University of Washington research centers, EIP claims a success rate of 35% for content removal, labeling and "soft-blocking." In fact, EIP staff worked 12–20-hour shifts from September through mid-November 2020 with an increase in monitoring the week before and after Election Day, an effort that flagged more than 4,800 URLs, shared nearly 22 million times on Twitter. House Homeland Security Committee member Kat Cammack (R-FL) said, "If Congress doesn't assert their authority, then what the heck are we doing?" It’s more vital than ever that voters hold Congress accountable for backing censorship by showing up at the polls this November.
---
| | |
---
[](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-nVKGZ6w)
---
[**Sign our petition through AlignAct**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._yMY9Mot1FQ) to tell Joe Biden and Congress that the federal government must stop the firing of US service members who do not get the Covid vaccine, and those who have already been discharged must be re-hired.
---
[TAKE ACTION](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
---
|
---
| | The United States risks slipping down a frightening slope towards cold showers and electricity blackouts should it pursue a European dedication to a green energy future. In the face of skyrocketing electricity prices and rampant fuel shortages, Europe has fully [embraced](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) its Green New Deal commitment to renewable energy at the expense of Europeans’ daily energy needs, causing them to adopt drastic energy-saving measures like taking showers together and cutting back their hot water use. “You don’t have to shower all the time,” said Green Party member and Prime Minister of Baden-Württemberg Winfried Kretschmann. “The washcloth is also a useful invention,” he said. Meanwhile, others argue that “passive cooking” could save up to 47% of the energy normally consumed by traditional cooking methods. Georgio Parisi, an Italian physicist and Nobel Prize winner, [encouraged](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTAzJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/l3jrV-KpkwfuKNmiLWbeSA) Italians to cook pasta without using too much energy by turning off the heat after bringing the water to a boil.

---
Use our [**newly updated AlignAct campaign**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._bWlkPTQ1OTAzJmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/OVTQriatEQIOmINRz1HpBQ) to tell Congress the following:
* You want to see hearings about the Biden administration's war on domestic oil and gas.
* You want oversight of Biden's Iran Nuclear Deal.
* You want to know why Biden is courting dictators and rogue leaders for oil, while killing the industry here.

Hello,
If you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. **Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right now headed by Donald J. Trump.**

| | Fellow Conservative,Even if conservatives take back Congress in November, Nancy Pelosi, Chuck Schumer, and the radical Left could still get their way for another year AFTER they lose. Here’s how...Congress just passed a short-term **continuing resolution (CR)** to appropriate money for the federal government. This CR expires on December 16—setting up another spending fight right before Christmas. In December, Pelosi and Schumer could pass one last **omnibus spending bill** to fund the government until October 2023... **_even if they lose BOTH chambers in November!_** And remember, spending bills are about more than just dollars and cents—they can be used to set the agenda and fund specific policies. Under Biden, government spending is driving higher inflation and funding open borders and even abortions in foreign countries. After the November elections, the new Congress won’t be sworn in until January. So a December spending bill would allow Schumer and Pelosi to fund Joe Biden’s failed agenda for a third year**—even after voters reject it!** At Heritage Action, we’re fighting to STOP the Democrats’ plans, but we need your voice to make the biggest impact. **Tell Congress: Don’t give Nancy Pelosi the credit card! Sign today >>**
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdhap2568f5brtb3v715s7dl3c5oqbiocrgoktc8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5i6eor6c3h2bs)
---
Fellow Conservative, we can’t let a lame duck Congress – **voted out by the people** – decide America’s future by pushing through a radical omnibus with far-Left priorities and zero debate. This would totally ignore the will of the American people and prevent conservatives in Congress from defunding the unpopular Biden agenda.
---

---
**If the Democrats pass an omnibus bill, some of Biden’s most radical policies will continue to haunt Americans...**
---
* His Title IX changes will go into effect
* The IRS’ ranks will be doubled
* Open border policies will persist

---
**Fellow Conservative, you won’t stand for this, right?****Join our fight and tell Congress to STOP the Biden-Schumer-Pelosi omnibus plan today >>** Heritage Action has been on _offense_ against the Biden administration, blocking a wide range of this administration’s priorities. **Wielding game-changing influence in Washington, our organization is successfully STOPPING major legislation in its tracks.**

name: Trudy Busch Valentine
subject: the chill that ran down my spine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
You have my word that as Missouri's next senator, I will work night and day to ensure that every family has access to high-quality, affordable healthcare.
| | |
---
Peter, when one of my sons was only 6 years old, he was attacked by a dog and got a terrible bite near his eye.
To this day, it remains one of the most nerve-wracking experiences of my life. **We were seriously concerned that my son might lose his eye entirely.** And to make matters more complex, we were out of town at the time and away from all of the doctors we would normally see.
I can still recall the chill that ran through my spine as we frantically took him to the nearest hospital. It didn't matter that I was a nurse – and that I'd seen plenty of injuries and wounds. **I still felt the same helplessness and fear that overtakes any mother when her child is in danger.**
On that day, I counted us as incredibly lucky to have found a hospital with doctors who could save his eye. **But when I think about that day now, I also recognize just how lucky we were to be able to focus so exclusively on our son's health and not about whether doctors or hospitals were in-network or whether our insurance would accept the claims.**
During my years as a nurse and again now on the campaign trail, I have heard so many stories about people rationing their insulin, mothers sitting in ER parking lots with their kids as they wait in case they deteriorate any further, and people not being able to afford the prescription drugs they need.
**There is simply no reason why this should happen.**
People should be able to focus exclusively on their well-being and the well-being of their loved ones – not haggling with their insurance companies and making sure they can afford both the care that they need and their mortgage or their next grocery bill.
Fixing this problem starts with electing leaders who will fight for real solutions and lift up the voices of families back home. **You have my word that as Missouri's next senator, I will work night and day to ensure that every family has access to high-quality, affordable healthcare – and I will get it done. clean_body: You have my word that as Missouri's next senator, I will work night and day to ensure that every family has access to high-quality, affordable healthcare. | | | Peter, when one of my sons was only 6 years old, he was attacked by a dog and got a terrible bite near his eye. To this day, it remains one of the most nerve-wracking experiences of my life. We were seriously concerned that my son might lose his eye entirely. And to make matters more complex, we were out of town at the time and away from all of the doctors we would normally see. I can still recall the chill that ran through my spine as we frantically took him to the nearest hospital. It didn't matter that I was a nurse – and that I'd seen plenty of injuries and wounds. I still felt the same helplessness and fear that overtakes any mother when her child is in danger. On that day, I counted us as incredibly lucky to have found a hospital with doctors who could save his eye. But when I think about that day now, I also recognize just how lucky we were to be able to focus so exclusively on our son's health and not about whether doctors or hospitals were in-network or whether our insurance would accept the claims. During my years as a nurse and again now on the campaign trail, I have heard so many stories about people rationing their insulin, mothers sitting in ER parking lots with their kids as they wait in case they deteriorate any further, and people not being able to afford the prescription drugs they need. There is simply no reason why this should happen. People should be able to focus exclusively on their well-being and the well-being of their loved ones – not haggling with their insurance companies and making sure they can afford both the care that they need and their mortgage or their next grocery bill. Fixing this problem starts with electing leaders who will fight for real solutions and lift up the voices of families back home. | | | Insider trading is illegal – yet some members of Congress buy and sell stock using highly relevant information that everyday Americans don’t have access to. At the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic, several members of Congress bought and sold stock based on what they learned in closed-door briefings. They were able to profit from insider knowledge. This is not just an unfair advantage, it’s a blatant conflict of interest. Congress can use information to benefit themselves and can make legislative decisions based on their potential profits. We deserve transparency from our representatives. It should be illegal for members of Congress to own and trade stock while they have access to private information. We need to turn up the pressure and hold Congress accountable. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Friend,
Today is a day where we celebrate, recognize, and honor the beautiful traditions and cultures of Indigenous people, not just in America, but around the world — today is **Indigenous People’s Day.**
[There’s a few ways you can celebrate Indigenous Peoples’ Day — check out some resources we collected for you!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52316998/371950455/-1987702686?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGJiYTkwNC1iZDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U7ZZqUSog3Xh1cqfI8jxlDPC9oL2jkVyuTbAMwEJEtQ=&emci=fca5499a-b148-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=98bba904-bd48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=6787172)
Last October marked the first time a U.S. president has officially recognized Indigenous Peoples' Day. President Biden issued a proclamation last year to observe the second Monday of October as a day to honor Native Americans, their resilience, and their contributions to American society throughout history, even as they faced forced assimilation, discrimination, and genocide spanning generations.
The move attempts to shift focus away from Columbus Day, the federal holiday celebrating Christopher Columbus. For Native Americans, Columbus Day is an annual reminder of the past 500 years of torture and oppression by European colonizers like Columbus and those who settled in America.
**In honor of Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we have an opportunity to reflect, recognize, celebrate and educate ourselves on the cultural richness and contributions of Indigenous and Afro-Indigenous people.**
[Take a few minutes to check out our resources on how you can recognize Indigenous Peoples’ Day.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52317000/371950458/741180669?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGJiYTkwNC1iZDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U7ZZqUSog3Xh1cqfI8jxlDPC9oL2jkVyuTbAMwEJEtQ=&emci=fca5499a-b148-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=98bba904-bd48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=6787172)
The harmful narratives and inaccuracies in Columbus’ legacy of his “discovery” of the Americas have been criticized for generations by Native Americans. Even though the proclamation is a step in the right direction, Columbus Day is still a federal holiday and still celebrated by the majority of our country. We can change this by continuing to put pressure on Congress to pass legislation that will change the second Monday of October to Indigenous Peoples’ Day.
This change helps increase visibility for Native people in the United States and helps pave the way for real progressive change across Indigenous communities. But for us to continue to accomplish bigger changes in our government **we have to protect, honor, and listen to Indigenous communities. **
When we take time to reflect on our history — as uncomfortable as it may be for some — we are taking the first step in acknowledging our troubled past. From there we can continue to educate ourselves and ultimately come together to fight for the protection and rights for all Afro-Indigneous and Indigenous people throughout our nation.
[Take action](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52317001/371950460/-824903272?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OGJiYTkwNC1iZDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U7ZZqUSog3Xh1cqfI8jxlDPC9oL2jkVyuTbAMwEJEtQ=&emci=fca5499a-b148-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=98bba904-bd48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=6787172 "CTA Button")

| | Dear Friend of Liberty, Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It’s not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It’s because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here’s the kicker. The Sacketts’ land is not wet. There’s no water on it! Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn’t comply with the EPA’s outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_! The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights—**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach. That’s why I’m emailing you today with a special request. I’m hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today. If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there’s no telling who could be next. But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA’s blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn0vnio96lvvam828e8d5s4ag2d85hjj8dpma5s0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5i69ob2cdh2bs)** For Liberty! Cristen Wohlgemuth President & CEO Mountain States Legal Foundation

| | Dear fellow Mississippians, The Dianne Black for Congress campaign is providing North Mississippi voters with a [sample ballot](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/71OEuCH1U/c?w=bgz4wknaZ7Y0nKNRtv4gnPsn7F79UnGDRlYsrqgnxUk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGlhbm5lZG9kc29uYmxhY2tmb3Jjb25ncmVzcy5jb20vc2FtcGxlLWJhbGxvdHMtbWlzc2lzc2lwcGkiLCJyIjoiNDU5ZWFiZjMtYzRmMi00YTVkLTA3YjgtMGIzNzIxYTBiYzFmIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiZDQ4N2ViZmYtZDdmNS00YWViLWFkYjMtMWFmY2QzNzU1OWJmIn0) for each of the 21 counties in the First Congressional District of Mississippi so they can prepare their vote for election day, Tuesday, November 8, 2022. No one likes to cram for final exams. It takes time to prepare, just like when you go to the voting booth to select the candidates who represent you. To promote voter education and preparation, the Dianne Black for Congress campaign has launched the “Plan Your Vote” campaign. In this 2022 mid-term election, there are a significant number of races. Voters will choose candidates for U.S. House of Representatives, Court of Appeals Judge, Chancery Court Judge, Circuit Court Judge, Levee Commissioners, County Court judge, and School Board. To plan your vote for these elections, follow three simple steps: Plan your vote.
* [Confirm you are registered to vote](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/71OEuCH1U/c?w=VYD3-nq8CpvrF23fe6bMbBEiOUIRaaFPZmdCtvc9jcU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubXNlZ292LmNvbS9zb3Mvdm90ZXJfcmVnaXN0cmF0aW9uL2FtaXJlZ2lzdGVyZWQvU2VhcmNoIiwiciI6IjQ1OWVhYmYzLWM0ZjItNGE1ZC0wN2I4LTBiMzcyMWEwYmMxZiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6ImQ0ODdlYmZmLWQ3ZjUtNGFlYi1hZGIzLTFhZmNkMzc1NTliZiJ9). Make sure you are registered by Monday, October 10 to avoid issues that cannot be resolved on election day.
* [Review your sample ballot](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/71OEuCH1U/c?w=bgz4wknaZ7Y0nKNRtv4gnPsn7F79UnGDRlYsrqgnxUk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGlhbm5lZG9kc29uYmxhY2tmb3Jjb25ncmVzcy5jb20vc2FtcGxlLWJhbGxvdHMtbWlzc2lzc2lwcGkiLCJyIjoiNDU5ZWFiZjMtYzRmMi00YTVkLTA3YjgtMGIzNzIxYTBiYzFmIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiZDQ4N2ViZmYtZDdmNS00YWViLWFkYjMtMWFmY2QzNzU1OWJmIn0). Look at the sample ballot for your county to learn who is running in your election.
* [Locate your polling place](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/71OEuCH1U/c?w=9JNmgfoM8xQKYdg-lSvO1MU-p2pm0IctrmBQmrzcV-8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc29zLm1zLmdvdi9lbGVjdGlvbnMtdm90aW5nL3BvbGxpbmctcGxhY2UtbG9jYXRvciIsInIiOiI0NTllYWJmMy1jNGYyLTRhNWQtMDdiOC0wYjM3MjFhMGJjMWYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJkNDg3ZWJmZi1kN2Y1LTRhZWItYWRiMy0xYWZjZDM3NTU5YmYifQ).

*Note: Each sample ballot provided is a compilation of all candidates running in all elections in that county, created to help residents plan their vote. Sample ballots may not be the actual ballot for a resident’s specific address. For example, in DeSoto County, James Eric Wright, who is running for school board District 1, appears on the District 1 ballot only. To see a specific ballot or to get further information visit the [Y'All Vote Secretary of State website](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/71OEuCH1U/c?w=fNWTxGZ3RuSDXHehmBMSopzU_goZaQkZf8R3FrA2PgE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc29zLm1zLmdvdi9pbmRleC5waHAveWFsbC12b3RlIiwiciI6IjQ1OWVhYmYzLWM0ZjItNGE1ZC0wN2I4LTBiMzcyMWEwYmMxZiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6ImQ0ODdlYmZmLWQ3ZjUtNGFlYi1hZGIzLTFhZmNkMzc1NTliZiJ9). Help pass out sample ballots.We have found that when voters know who is on the ballot, they feel more confident and are more likely to vote. Dianne’s campaign plans to share a sample ballot for every county on her [website](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/71OEuCH1U/c?w=vx5lqE9w40tDbfIzoEUEXvWekX3Hcehuax0Kvg37_yo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZGlhbm5lZG9kc29uYmxhY2tmb3Jjb25ncmVzcy5jb20iLCJyIjoiNDU5ZWFiZjMtYzRmMi00YTVkLTA3YjgtMGIzNzIxYTBiYzFmIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiZDQ4N2ViZmYtZDdmNS00YWViLWFkYjMtMWFmY2QzNzU1OWJmIn0). Please consider making copies and sharing. Encourage qualified voters to absentee vote. Absentee voting began Monday, September 26 at all County Circuit Clerk offices and ends on Saturday, November 5 at noon for qualified voters. Bad weather and long lines may dissuade some voters from casting their ballot on the one election day in Mississippi. There is no early voting in Mississippi! If you or someone you know is eligible to vote absentee, go ahead and vote! Do not wait until November 8. Peter, As Democrat-run cities are besieged by crime and mayhem, Florida is supporting law enforcement and keeping our communities safe.

Far-Left extremists are hell-bent on smearing and defunding the law enforcement officers who risk their lives daily to protect our communities.

Leftist politicians and Soros-backed prosecutors are enabling chaos and undermining the law enforcement profession by letting violent criminals walk free with hardly a slap on the wrist.

In other states, repeat offenders are receiving unlimited “get out of jail free” cards and free rein to disrespect the rule of law. [**Reject the Left’s woke agenda – Rush in your support >>>**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a1dbb57f334b470d9f0a1a0995031263&_e=L3OIFQvshqGICIJlfdYMZuBDp2llMf1WVIqLtsi7Hcip8y7An8M0bfwsqnGzJ5J7e0SA5Ubpw0YVviCfQRPAVzqTpkIPKzFNLAz9oEvXwvKcEM4a5mlQfgBGIzPx7yulnPV9Z4sA6lRQTPt7OVrP9kt-XjxgyqQjxm3LYHd2wZTX_5YGHnJ4SZ-2YF0LfIb3fo7jn0uFADC9zZdBTTUuQgGFPdke2jdf3r3P_ryCQ6zSq6nhTT9dAuTMo5ejWUaCu_V_6f2rhjtGsUV7cEusDAJL-MCtwLeYjKd3nC_rfs8E40ZvHmqVhCb-jdUHpm8Lal1WxqMpKH0jKWbSFzt97MtCuBHAjCfh_gda6wu32u4%3D "Reject the Left’s woke agenda – Rush in your support>>>")

The Left and their corporate media lapdogs don’t want you to see the destruction their woke agenda is inflicting on communities across the nation, so they’re doing what they do best: deflecting.

My opponent has not been shy about his support for reallocation and defunding of police departments. But unlike my opponent and the Soros-funded prosecutors whose pro-crime ideology has made once-great cities unlivable, **I’m not beholden to anyone but the people of Florida.**

**And as Governor, I have worked to ensure that Florida is a law-and-order state.**

Supporting our law enforcement heroes, pursuing justice for victims, and keeping our communities safe are not Left vs. Right issues. They’re right vs. wrong issues – which is why I’ve been endorsed by Democrat elected officials like Palm Beach County Commissioner Dave Kerner. As a former law enforcement officer, Dave rejects those in his party – including my opponent – who have embraced the disastrous “defund the police” agenda.

When I look a police officer in the eye and say, “I have your back,” I don’t just say it – **I follow through.**
[**HELP ME KEEP FLORIDA SAFE!**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a1dbb57f334b470d9f0a1a0995031263&_e=L3OIFQvshqGICIJlfdYMZuBDp2llMf1WVIqLtsi7Hcip8y7An8M0bfwsqnGzJ5J7e0SA5Ubpw0YVviCfQRPAVzqTpkIPKzFNLAz9oEvXwvKcEM4a5mlQfgBGIzPx7yulnPV9Z4sA6lRQTPt7OVrP9kt-XjxgyqQjxm3LYHd2wZTX_5YGHnJ4SZ-2YF0LfIb3fo7jn0uFADC9zZdBTTUuQkSXjvbYEj1rYNd-y6b4prP7yj0N1MBwTV1MB91SbKcT2T4NVKHkzk-klHat_uvOjTFDaRlMSUJn2HrzOnV_wCbpMNBDlPipt3eQ8yYzVyNkkmtRZgphoRmUGsVUd6UY1lW696bN_wCrn729x5JB4aw%3D "HELP ME KEEP FLORIDA SAFE!RUSH IN YOUR IMMEDIATE SUPPORT>>>") [**RUSH IN YOUR IMMEDIATE SUPPORT >>>**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a1dbb57f334b470d9f0a1a0995031263&_e=L3OIFQvshqGICIJlfdYMZuBDp2llMf1WVIqLtsi7Hcip8y7An8M0bfwsqnGzJ5J7e0SA5Ubpw0YVviCfQRPAVzqTpkIPKzFNLAz9oEvXwvKcEM4a5mlQfgBGIzPx7yulnPV9Z4sA6lRQTPt7OVrP9kt-XjxgyqQjxm3LYHd2wZTX_5YGHnJ4SZ-2YF0LfIb3fo7jn0uFADC9zZdBTTUuQkjxbk-F0zd2LIaD6-wWNfp0ZM56wWeSG2XI11jnzfJpFR1EgGJhksB2GtMFg8FD4mZRIerxI1FCV-4LlNJyezCuueiPCvun9x9YUHKhO6ChtcgB2r10HJvfMDlqBFTPUkEznWczsmxv3vhGCA_1q9s%3D "HELP ME KEEP FLORIDA SAFE!RUSH IN YOUR IMMEDIATE SUPPORT>>>")
As Governor, I have a responsibility to lead. But I also have the opportunity to make a difference and get things done.

In Florida, we’ve led with purpose and conviction. Because of that, we’ve produced results better than anybody thought possible.

**The good news is... we’re just getting started.**

My opponent’s extreme agenda and admiration of Soros-backed policies only fuel my resolve to fight woke tyranny and Keep Florida Free.

D.C. Democrats are desperate to derail our progress and turn our great state into a crime-ridden dystopia.

That’s why your support is so important, Peter. There’s more on the line than just celebrating a victory in November.

**We’re in a fight to safeguard our state.**

The safety of our families and our communities is on the line. We cannot sit idly by as far-Left extremists try to dismantle our way of life and trample on the rule of law.

They would love nothing more than to see Florida face the same fate as progressive jurisdictions overrun by violent crime. We cannot allow their twisted nightmare to become reality.

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I want to tell you a story about the first time I visited the Governor’s
Mansion. But first, I need your help to reach our ambitious goal of
raising $120,000 per day from now through the start of Early Vote on
October 17 to ensure we turn out our voters.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221010_B1_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=11378%2E1862389%2E0y5z_T ]Will you invest $5 in my campaign right now to build One
Georgia, where health care, housing, education and a good living are
accessible to all — and where our children are safe and surrounded by
opportunity and possibility? Your $5 donation will help us
open the gates of opportunity across Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221010_B1_SYAValedictorian_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=11378%2E1862389%2E0y5z_T ]DONATE

In 1991, I graduated as the valedictorian of Avondale High School. Like
most Georgia valedictorians, I was invited to meet the Governor of Georgia
at the Governor’s Mansion.

It was a big deal for my family. That morning, I got up and put on my
Sunday best. My parents and I boarded the MARTA bus with the domestic
workers and mechanics who, like us, could not afford a car.

We took MARTA all the way from DeKalb County to Buckhead, got off at West
Paces Ferry Road, and walked up the long driveway to the big black gates
around the property. When we got to the guard station, the guard looked at
my parents, then he looked at me and said, “This is a private event, you
don’t belong here.”

He looked over our shoulders at the MARTA bus driving away, and he told
himself a story about who would be on that bus — and in his story, they
did not belong in the Governor’s Mansion.

---
**Super Saturday**
The energy on Saturday was incredible! Val Guest, Heather Crawford, and I joined Team GOP to knock on doors in the Grand Strand. We had nearly 1,000 voter contacts. Huge shoutout to the volunteers who beat the streets with us! We had great weather and even better responses from voters.

If you want to join Team Victory next time, sign up to volunteer [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=a41cd3ed80&e=7aa6ac5965)!

**In The News **
I joined Fox Across America with Jimmy Failla yesterday for a great interview where we discussed the election climate in South Carolina, the opioid crisis, and on a lighter note, my 8th-grade ping pong championship title.

Watch the full interview [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=70181f30ee&e=7aa6ac5965).

I published an op-ed in The Washington Times about the need for a secure border to help solve the opioid crisis.

I'm urging this administration to set politics aside. Look at what the out-of-control border is doing to American families in border states and across the country.

Read my full article [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=e2defd308f&e=7aa6ac5965).

"His service to our country as a Member of Congress, CIA director, and Secretary of State is inspiring, and I am grateful to have his backing as we fight to get our country back on track."

This election isn't going to win itself. We need everything you can give to dethrone the Democrats! Click [here](https://RussellFrySC.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a41df098de9eb0c2ebc47c51a&id=927bdd5691&e=7aa6ac5965) to donate.

Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, unveils his next campaign ad in the general election focused on the 2019 Colorado law making a lethal amount of fentanyl a misdemeanor.

"Too many families in Colorado and across the nation have suffered from the fentanyl crisis coming through our open borders," stated Aadland. "Fentanyl deaths are up 384% since this time last year and there have already been over 1,000 fentanyl deaths in 2022 because many victims are unaware this is the drug they are taking. These overdoses have impacted more parents than we ever could have expected. Unfortunately, a major contributor to these overdoses is the lack of proper punishment for the criminals distributing this toxic narcotic. Our children must be protected and the perpetrators to these overdoses must be punished. The soft-on-crime law sponsored by my opponent in 2019, which lessened the punishment for possession of a lethal amount of fentanyl, has harmed Colorado families. We need leadership in Washington that helps keep our families safe by putting the hammer down on criminals with stiff sentences."
|

| Today there are more empty desks in schools, More children without mothers, Fathers without sons In 2019, Colorado passed a law to make a lethal amount of fentanyl just a misdemeanor. Democrats are working to fix the damage, But If Brittney's ideas are too extreme for Democrats Why would we send her to Washington? I'm Erik Aadland and I approve this message.

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

clean_body: | | Friend, We’re so excited to announce that Brenda has been endorsed by Congressman Peter Welch! **** "Brenda Siegel has been a tireless advocate for Vermonters. Brenda's lived experience allows her to connect with people from every walk of life. She will continue to fight for a Vermont that works for all of us by improving access to affordable housing, addressing the overdose crisis, and supporting working families. She brings valuable and critical leadership to public service which helps strengthen our communities and state. I support Brenda Siegel and hope you will too this November.” – U.S. Congressman Peter Welch | Brenda is honored to have earned the congressman’s support, “I have had the opportunity to work with Congressman Welch on drug policy among other things, and one of the things that astounds me most about him is that he always listens to advocates on the ground and values the work that they are doing enough to turn to them for advice on issues he is working on in congress. I am so honored to have received the endorsement of Peter Welch and to have earned his trust to become Vermont’s next Governor.” As governor, Brenda looks forward to working with Peter to deliver proactive leadership for the future of Vermont. Today we recognize Indigenous peoples’ resilience and strength, and our obligation to tell the truth about our history. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52322556/371968885/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzljOWE5Yi1jOTQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uHRI0l6qSU1Q_3fkc3oY2CpTyaV-g0gGSXtck0zg9Io=&emci=5e45d6bc-b548-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=a79c9a9b-c948-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=43402272) | Peter, Today is Indigenous Peoples’ Day – a day of both celebration and mourning in America. Today we share, acknowledge, and celebrate the stories and contributions of Native Americans while grappling with the harmful reality of colonization, which is the crowning legacy of Christopher Columbus. It is part of our American history that Native people have been displaced from their ancestral lands, and their culture and religion repressed through many generations of forced assimilation. It is also part of our history that Native Americans were the original protectors of this land and the environment, and continue to be its most vocal advocates. It is part of our history that Native Americans serve this country in the United States Armed Forces at a higher rate than any other group, and are scholars, artists, doctors, activists and so much more. And it is part of our history that Native Americans have suffered from our government’s many broken promises and discriminatory policies, and have been denied access to many opportunities because of it. Acknowledging our past fully is essential if we are going to move forward and change the future. In Vermont, we can and must do better to repair the harm that has been done by ensuring equitable access to resources, including land for Indigenous people who continue to call Vermont home. If elected as your next member of Congress, I will be committed to collaborating with Vermont’s Indigenous tribes to build an equitable and sustainable future for all of us. We’re building a coalition that includes everyone – striving to give a voice to all Vermonters in Washington – including members of Indigenous tribes. I hope you’ll join me in taking some time out of your day to learn more, celebrate, and honor Indigenous people and their stories, contributions, and histories. Thank you, Becca Balint

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Fear.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
All across the country, Republicans are using fear to divide people in the hopes that they can regain control of Congress.
#

Friends -
All across the country, Republicans are using fear to divide people in the hopes that they can regain control of Congress.
But if you ask some of those politicians in swing districts why they’ve voted against bills that would make our communities safer from gun violence, some will privately tell you it’s because of their own fear — fear of the gun lobby.
But I think their fear must be nothing like the fear those children in Uvalde felt as they were trapped in their classroom for over an hour while their friends lay dead on the ground.
That fear must be nothing like the fear parents feel when they receive an alert about an active shooter at their child’s school.
That fear must be nothing like the fear a woman feels when an abusive partner shows up at her home knocking on the door, armed and angry.
Every day politicians choose fear of the gun lobby over the courage to act, they choose to accept the epidemic levels of gun violence in this country.
But the truth is, this cycle CAN come to an end. And this November, we have a chance to take an important step in that direction.
I cannot do it alone. I need your help. Because after November, it’s too late. We’ll have to wait another two years if we come up short, and that is just too long.
So please:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to Giffords PAC before our mid-month fundraising deadline — the last before Election Day — comes to an end in just a few days? **[Your support is urgent, and it’s necessary if I’m going to win my critical battleground race, so I do hope you’ll chip in $3](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52323107/371970387/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1773-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2ZlYWFhZi1jYjQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kxvnk9oytjwU82MTr9kozCV6s6YyIWImv3umospN_a0=)**. But I also think that you deserve to know a bit more about how I see the stakes of this election, so even though this email is a little longer than the ones I usually send, I hope you’ll take a moment to read it, folks.
My father was a WWII veteran who survived the Battle of the Bulge; he knew what the decay of democracy looked like because he saw it up close – and he fought it, in service to his country.
His example has always inspired me. It is no small part of why I have pursued a life in public service.
He took freedom very seriously, and he made sure that my siblings and I did too. Throughout my childhood, he would peer over his newspaper at the breakfast table and ask me and my siblings “what are you doing for freedom today?”
That question is one I still think about to this day. Because freedom is not a given. It is an ongoing and – as his question reflects – daily fight.
[**It’s a fight that I am taking up here in New Hampshire, as I work to protect this Senate seat. And I hope it is a fight that you will join me in today because the outcome of this race – for a seat I won by the slimmest margin of any sitting Senator – will echo across the country.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52323108/371970388/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1773-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2ZlYWFhZi1jYjQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kxvnk9oytjwU82MTr9kozCV6s6YyIWImv3umospN_a0=)
I wish it were hyperbole to say that our fundamental freedoms are at stake in this race, but it’s not. And that is in large part because Republicans have selected Don Bolduc – the most extreme right-wing Senate nominee that New Hampshire has seen in living memory – to face me in November.
Don Bolduc’s anti-choice record makes it clear he would tear away a woman’s right to be a full and equal citizen, and his peddling of the Big Lie continues to damage the very foundations of our democracy.
**[We must defeat him and the dangerous right-wing extremism he represents. And you are an integral part of that effort, folks.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52323109/371970389/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1773-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2ZlYWFhZi1jYjQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Kxvnk9oytjwU82MTr9kozCV6s6YyIWImv3umospN_a0=)**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52308424/371914264/-4707655?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTNkN2FjYi1hYTQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BRCSiQWY0CsI_zNd6Emgn1vCQwcbwbRk5hT1YxZsAcg=&emci=ed3d7acb-aa48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=ee3d7acb-aa48-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=19954364) Team, For the last few weeks, a right-wing super PAC has been filling up voters’ mailboxes, and sending thousands of text messages, attacking Brittany in personal, vicious — and false — terms. If you live in the 7th District, you might have seen it for yourself. It turns out, the tactics this group is engaging in are even uglier than they seemed, and they likely broke the law. Who were your heroes growing up, friend? For me, it was my parents.
Dad was a veteran, a small businessman, and a preacher. He spent his days fixing junk cars that other folks had discarded – and then on Sundays, he preached to the folks who felt discarded.

And Mom? As a teenager, she spent her summers picking cotton in Waycross, Georgia. She raised 12 kids in public housing – and while our family was short on money, we were long on love. **Just last year, those 83-year-old hands that used to pick somebody else's cotton picked her son to be a U.S. senator from Georgia, the first Black senator in our state's history.**
My parents taught me the value of hard work and instilled in me a heart for service. I bring those lessons with me wherever I go, including the Senate, where I'm fighting to build a better, brighter future for all.

**But with _NPR_ calling me the most vulnerable Democratic senator up for reelection, I mean it when I say the only way I can win this race and keep up the fight in Washington is with your urgent help.**

| | Dear Friend of Liberty, Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It’s not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It’s because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here’s the kicker. The Sacketts’ land is not wet. There’s no water on it! Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn’t comply with the EPA’s outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_! The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights—**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach. That’s why I’m emailing you today with a special request. I’m hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today. If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there’s no telling who could be next. But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA’s blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zh0be9k3e2vspbl2839sr6h9khp39eu0a1ouf1jg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c5h61ob4clh2bs)** For Liberty! Cristen Wohlgemuth President & CEO Mountain States Legal Foundation

_“My definition of patriotism was when I left my family and I put on the uniform of this country. When I was leading soldiers in combat, no question I ever once asked them was ‘what’s your political party?’ It didn’t come up. So the idea that somehow someone can come up and claim that they have a greater grasp of patriotism or love of their country is foolish. So I would challenge anybody, or any political party, who thinks they have the monopoly cornered on what they think it means to be a patriot.”_

name: Dr. Kim Schrier
subject: Running for office was never in my life plan.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress
body:
I want to tell you the story of how I came to Congress. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52311663/371927465/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDA1NjY2Zi1iMDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=umz32LzQodNwcy-CwAlbmBGocwQBzJaLXK-DkCqY1So=&emci=cb50f6e1-a648-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=3405666f-b048-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=15820338)
---
In a moment, I'm going to ask you to **[contribute to my campaign to keep WA-08 blue](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52311664/371927466/474784691?refcode=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDA1NjY2Zi1iMDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=umz32LzQodNwcy-CwAlbmBGocwQBzJaLXK-DkCqY1So=)** , but first, I want to let you know why I first chose to run for Congress.

I never imagined I'd run for office, Peter.

When I was sixteen years old, I was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. I always had a love for science (here I am winning an academic decathlon when I was in high school!), and my experience managing my diabetes and all the time I spent in doctors’ offices helped lead me to a career as a pediatrician. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52311665/371927467/474784691?refcode=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDA1NjY2Zi1iMDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=umz32LzQodNwcy-CwAlbmBGocwQBzJaLXK-DkCqY1So=) For sixteen years, I served thousands of families in Issaquah as a doctor. I loved my patients and my work. Running for office was never in my "life plan." [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52311666/371927468/474784691?refcode=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDA1NjY2Zi1iMDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=umz32LzQodNwcy-CwAlbmBGocwQBzJaLXK-DkCqY1So=) But throughout my career, I saw firsthand how important access to quality, affordable health care was for my patients. That's why when my own representative voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act, that was the final straw for me.

So, I packed up my office and left the job I love to run for Congress. I had a sense that I could do more good for more children and families in Washington's 8th District from a seat in the House of Representatives than I ever could in the 4 walls of my exam room. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52311667/371927469/474784691?refcode=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDA1NjY2Zi1iMDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=umz32LzQodNwcy-CwAlbmBGocwQBzJaLXK-DkCqY1So=) I knew it wasn't going to be easy – no Democrat had ever represented Washington's 8th District before. But folks from all across the district came together to join me because they believed in what I was fighting for: affordable health care, a clean environment, education, and so much more. In fact, many of the people who joined me to knock doors and get out the vote were my patients and their families! It was incredible and heartwarming.

**Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we flipped Washington's 8th District blue for the first time ever in 2018 and kept it blue in 2020.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52311668/371927470/474784691?refcode=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDA1NjY2Zi1iMDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=umz32LzQodNwcy-CwAlbmBGocwQBzJaLXK-DkCqY1So=) Since coming to Congress, I have been focused on fighting for the issues that matter most to you, me, and all the families I served as a pediatrician.

We've accomplished so much over the past three years, but there's more work ahead of us. That's why I'm running for re-election. But protecting my seat won't be easy. National Republicans have named this district a top target and election experts are saying this race will be a "toss-up." That’s alarming when there is so much at stake in this election.

I don't accept a dime of corporate PAC money. That means to fight back against the nearly $7 million being spent to defeat me, I'm counting on your support.

**[Will you chip in $5 or more to my re-election campaign? Together, we can keep this seat blue and continue making progress for the 8th District.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52311669/371927471/474784691?refcode=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221010_bio_fnd_gq_act___dks_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNDA1NjY2Zi1iMDQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=umz32LzQodNwcy-CwAlbmBGocwQBzJaLXK-DkCqY1So=)**

Thank you,

clean_body: I want to tell you the story of how I came to Congress. In a moment, I'm going to ask you to = , but first, I want to let you know why I first chose to run for Congress. I never imagined I'd run for office, Peter. When I was sixteen years old, I was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. I always had a love for science (here I am winning an academic decathlon when I was in high school!), and my experience managing my diabetes and all the time I spent in doctors’ offices helped lead me to a career as a pediatrician. = For sixteen years, I served thousands of families in Issaquah as a doctor. I loved my patients and my work. Running for office was never in my "life plan." = But throughout my career, I saw firsthand how important access to quality, affordable health care was for my patients. That's why when my own representative voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act, that was the final straw for me. So, I packed up my office and left the job I love to run for Congress. I had a sense that I could do more good for more children and families in Washington's 8th District from a seat in the House of Representatives than I ever could in the 4 walls of my exam room. = I knew it wasn't going to be easy – no Democrat had ever represented Washington's 8th District before. But folks from all across the district came together to join me because they believed in what I was fighting for: affordable health care, a clean environment, education, and so much more. In fact, many of the people who joined me to knock doors and get out the vote were my patients and their families! It was incredible and heartwarming. Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we flipped Washington's 8th District blue for the first time ever in 2018 and kept it blue in 2020. = Since coming to Congress, I have been focused on fighting for the issues that matter most to you, me, and all the families I served as a pediatrician. We've accomplished so much over the past three years, but there's more work ahead of us. That's why I'm running for re-election. But protecting my seat won't be easy.
