name: Patty Pansing Brooks
subject: Indigenous Peoples Day
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY PATTY FOR CONGRESS
body:
We must commit to allyship and justice for Indigenous people every. single. day.

|
---
| | Dear friend, Today, we celebrate Indigenous people across our country. This day signifies not only the incredible progress we’ve made to better represent, support, and listen to our Indigenous community — it signifies the work that still remains in our fight to ensure each and every person in this country has the resources they need to thrive. This year, we now have eight Indigenous people serving in the United States House of Representatives. The importance of electing leaders who bring a new perspective — and who are so often underrepresented in our country’s highest level of government — cannot be emphasized enough. The reality that people in power have violated treaties, refused representation, and left Indigenous communities’ needs unmet is simply unacceptable in a country that champions equality for all. **And this November, I will be _honored_ to work with leaders like Mary Peltola, Kaiali’i Kahele, Sharice Davids, and Gregorio Kilili Camacho Sablan in the fight to be a voice for our most vulnerable communities.** Working with Senator Tom Brewer to enact Indigenous Peoples Day as an official state holiday in Nebraska has been among my most gratifying accomplishments in the Nebraska Legislature. But while today represents a good starting point for uplifting our Indigenous communities, we must commit to allyship and justice for Indigenous people _every. single. day._ In the fights for clean air and water, equitable representation, and tribal rights, I affirm my own dedication to advocating for and standing alongside Native communities here in Nebraska and across the country. Today, let us honor these vast and beautiful Indigenous histories, their cultures and contributions, and the resilience of native people in the face of oppression that still persists. Together, Patty Pansing Brooks

We’ll be quick, Peter – we have four hours left until our 48-hour deadline ends and we see whether we successfully turned our fundraising around. We have 23 hours before our deadline and according to my team, around $6,000 left to raise. [**If 238 people donate our average of $25.29, we’ll get there – so will you be one of the generous donors to help us reach our goal and make my day?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/19169?refcode=em20221010-1698&t=3&akid=1698%2E420207%2E3vPeSy)

We are so powerful when we come together, but it takes work to keep this movement going. [**If you’ve been waiting for the right time to invest in our work, please consider making a donation right now so we can raise this last $6,000.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/19169?refcode=em20221010-1698&t=4&akid=1698%2E420207%2E3vPeSy)

Pramila

Peter,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Peter, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=fca83be101724042b313881506c63c39&_e=FIegVFvqsAnS3K-IpsWd_PlKUHa5xG_FuopeHFhv99VTlJjKUoqGXKDYUdGWQgDCPgOV_dcUQ7bLn7V1EAA75QtKZ0xb7bHyT8NOyDlt9QkMgDp1y833CeeTmWiAOHpb8-Zue2A5ZzCXVejeo2dgQIRkyCy-9VIrm8mdyqXxzHQgnXWvydQBkqGjqFD2aGeddgmAuA4aMCyalt91rV-QlqiuJGlsnYIuFXoevNQ39sFnOBJsES1dc4FaHFKvIFkBb0oCHi8UVjElh7MD7pNxiEpG5FBjmueWOk0VNEO-w5sb1aHoixiCIOg3qw7PlVHTosxG9SUlvui2JhuqP_dORa8z9YuU9y3mXwfgezHBFjzzYBFqzARYGQhuC_oqaP5hUWUZj8LEQTRn74HjutTWcw%3D%3D) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

**The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.**

Mental health challenges are a serious epidemic in this country, and I saw this first-hand when I worked at the Pentagon. Our veterans give everything to this country and often need extra support when they return.

The truth is we need to do better, and we need our lawmakers to fully address the issue of mental health for our kids, our workers, and our veterans.

body:
Early voting officially starts in two weeks.
#
Most people don’t know this, but timing is _everything_ when it comes to voter outreach.
The conversations that we have with voters make them more likely to vote if they take place starting about _two weeks before_ early voting. **Early voting starts October 24, so TODAY (October 10) is the first big opportunity we have to ensure that we actually increase voter turnout.**
[**We’re in crunch time with these two critical weeks starting TODAY. We’re (respectfully) asking that if you’re able to — can you please pitch in $3 today to support our voter outreach program?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221010-1.MsVxVQ&refcode=ema20221010-211866&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=211866%2E444211%2ERbL9yQ)

name: Pete Sepp
subject: The next energy crisis: America
body:
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8b6bdcc916ff42bfa61b37f27f4625ef&_e=0hU5tDArzDadq4lXsR7-T9BN40WWAOXtaxBpuWq2gNU_1MqPrW6m9J_bKaAaLnQULoj9C69GcKfeDDr_9pLi9NuzOAKoeiqUiOEnxVfIeOC6mv6j_66PPLmQO2ABwNhV3JPbkw9aTc48G5sEqhfLl8f_sYmw4XU781nCcyl63nvkrRRRZfu7WjU-rm8DL5lM9YrzcT11T6M5WMBPIKCpA8qF6jzX0UwLfO53aT6wVOiyH7B70aaAw-Dmuy_4gLwADFxMQ4CLQN5qM7jvDdX1Yv2J4en9YtFohVxEfT8haJ0%3D)
Friend,

Germany, England, and many in Europe are experiencing an energy crisis.

But it doesn't have to be this way.

Yes, there is a war in Ukraine, which has created a dramatic shift in the energy industry.

But the roots of their energy crisis began years ago, with Europe's domestic policies that are actively shutting down energy production in favor of _"Green"_ energy solutions.

**And unless changes happen, the Biden administration will import this energy crisis to America.**

Let me introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union. My team and I are working with members of Congress to increase America’s energy independence.

[**Can you chip in $10, $35, $50, or any amount to support our work with Congress? Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8b6bdcc916ff42bfa61b37f27f4625ef&_e=0hU5tDArzDadq4lXsR7-T9BN40WWAOXtaxBpuWq2gNU_1MqPrW6m9J_bKaAaLnQULoj9C69GcKfeDDr_9pLi9NuzOAKoeiqUiOEnxVfIeOC6mv6j_66PPLmQO2ABwNhV3JPbkw9aTc48G5sEqhfLlxLj1ySuzxqU75TKVDLI4ofm3naukfauwtrYKPNaJECLXnPfNNgKOYcevv8PXe8Lehf4n-OsfAwfB2lJnssUB25rsQAAc3dowCaoUpk5FtBkG_7151I2n5vzsViIBA4IqrSmQoNnHiC4Z7RD-v1-Xss%3D)

I have no problem with green energy in itself. I approve of any sound policy that inspires the innovative spirit and provides all Americans with cleaner, more affordable energy.

**But I support more of an _“all the above”_ approach to energy policy.**

And right now, all too many politicians are using Green policies to pick winners in the energy sector. This only leads to higher prices, more corruption, and increased incompetence. _In the end, it’s the consumer who loses_.

President Biden set the tone on his first day by canceling the Keystone Pipeline, which could have moved **510,000 barrels of oil per day** if completed.

The Administration has also restricted the leasing and permitting of drilling on federal lands. They have approved the smallest acreage of oil and gas leases since World War 2.

Congress has also proposed implementing a windfall profits tax on the energy providers in our country. Such a tax would limit supply at a time when demand is high, and increasing supply is of the utmost importance.

The comically misnamed “Inflation Reduction Act” already slapped a “methane emissions charge” on natural gas, meaning Americans will likely pay higher prices for heating and electricity.

[**We can have a thriving energy production and market here in the U.S. but only if we convince Congress to take action. Can you chip in $10, $35, $50, or any amount to support our work with Congress? Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8b6bdcc916ff42bfa61b37f27f4625ef&_e=0hU5tDArzDadq4lXsR7-T9BN40WWAOXtaxBpuWq2gNU_1MqPrW6m9J_bKaAaLnQULoj9C69GcKfeDDr_9pLi9NuzOAKoeiqUiOEnxVfIeOC6mv6j_66PPLmQO2ABwNhV3JPbkw9aTc48G5sEqhfLlxSmVCZGbIegkbt8YncL2XhBjnZ_MokpYE_Q2V9xoLyIvMHMVK__EUfw7C9B1U4tPFlGSp6jgFZHRHHWfETyBogVQyZYHZXugf3FjxFjq2bAg9HgCyXHJGVV0LTmcOVNRbCf8QGYlREPmQriU0Zn_60%3D)

Congress needs to listen if they wish to improve the energy crisis soon.

Unfortunately, some in Washington have pushed for heavy-handed government mandates and taxes in the energy sector.

This is a misguided approach.

**Congress needs to make changes to the tax code** , like the full and permanent expensing of research and development (R&D) investments. Simple changes like that will help unleash innovation in energy production.

Additionally, we support thoughtful approaches to incentivize emissions reductions, like the Growing Climate Solutions Act, which facilitates the _voluntary_ disclosure of such activities.

Free market solutions are the best way to create an environment that allows our innovators, entrepreneurs, and thought leaders to bring about cleaner, more affordable energy solutions.

**You and I can steer Congress away from counterproductive energy policy proposals. And that advice is needed now more than ever!**

[**Your urgent donation will help NTU get American energy production back on track. Please donate $10, $35, $50, or even $100 today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=8b6bdcc916ff42bfa61b37f27f4625ef&_e=0hU5tDArzDadq4lXsR7-T9BN40WWAOXtaxBpuWq2gNU_1MqPrW6m9J_bKaAaLnQULoj9C69GcKfeDDr_9pLi9NuzOAKoeiqUiOEnxVfIeOC6mv6j_66PPLmQO2ABwNhV3JPbkw9aTc48G5sEqhfLl3ncTVHhOSRJc1nZn5JRlb0t36DXHAIf5IyjYT994DE8T5OkUsLnciyzyNlCHiG59GRtU891Zhr7slh88MgK_viXgFIdPiqa0T1P7wW7BHUPh26DYCuFON8Y7JknIJrDzIknHVyIkbSyyW8B4ParZMo%3D)

Since our founding in 1969, **NTU has been involved in EVERY major legislative effort in Washington that affects taxpayers.** Our lobbying skills, media savvy, policy expertise, and reputation for advancing pragmatic solutions are unrivaled.

We have provided Congress with a foundational roadmap of policies that can increase supply and protect America from the global ebbs of the energy economy.

But we need your support to get their attention.

Can you fight the energy crisis by helping NTU meet our goal of raising $10,000 in the next 48 hours? **Click any link below to donate today. **

clean_body: Friend, Germany, England, and many in Europe are experiencing an energy crisis. But it doesn't have to be this way. Yes, there is a war in Ukraine, which has created a dramatic shift in the energy industry. But the roots of their energy crisis began years ago, with Europe's domestic policies that are actively shutting down energy production in favor of "Green" energy solutions. And unless changes happen, the Biden administration will import this energy crisis to America. Let me introduce myself. My name is Pete Sepp, President of the National Taxpayers Union. My team and I are working with members of Congress to increase America’s energy independence. I have no problem with green energy in itself. I approve of any sound policy that inspires the innovative spirit and provides all Americans with cleaner, more affordable energy. But I support more of an “all the above” approach to energy policy. And right now, all too many politicians are using Green policies to pick winners in the energy sector. This only leads to higher prices, more corruption, and increased incompetence. In the end, it’s the consumer who loses. President Biden set the tone on his first day by canceling the Keystone Pipeline, which could have moved 510,000 barrels of oil per day if completed. The Administration has also restricted the leasing and permitting of drilling on federal lands. They have approved the smallest acreage of oil and gas leases since World War 2. Congress has also proposed implementing a windfall profits tax on the energy providers in our country. Such a tax would limit supply at a time when demand is high, and increasing supply is of the utmost importance. The comically misnamed “Inflation Reduction Act” already slapped a “methane emissions charge” on natural gas, meaning Americans will likely pay higher prices for heating and electricity. Congress needs to listen if they wish to improve the energy crisis soon. Unfortunately, some in Washington have pushed for heavy-handed government mandates and taxes in the energy sector. This is a misguided approach. Congress needs to make changes to the tax code , like the full and permanent expensing of research and development (R&D) investments. Simple changes like that will help unleash innovation in energy production. Additionally, we support thoughtful approaches to incentivize emissions reductions, like the Growing Climate Solutions Act, which facilitates the voluntary disclosure of such activities. Free market solutions are the best way to create an environment that allows our innovators, entrepreneurs, and thought leaders to bring about cleaner, more affordable energy solutions. You and I can steer Congress away from counterproductive energy policy proposals. And that advice is needed now more than ever! Since our founding in 1969, NTU has been involved in EVERY major legislative effort in Washington that affects taxpayers. Our lobbying skills, media savvy, policy expertise, and reputation for advancing pragmatic solutions are unrivaled. We have provided Congress with a foundational roadmap of policies that can increase supply and protect America from the global ebbs of the energy economy. But we need your support to get their attention. Can you fight the energy crisis by helping NTU meet our goal of raising $10,000 in the next 48 hours? Click any link below to donate today. Thank you for helping us advocate for taxpayers! Pete Sepp President National Taxpayers Union NTU is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit, nonpartisan citizen group whose members work every day for lower taxes and smaller government at all levels. Friend,
As Democrat-run cities are besieged by crime and mayhem, Florida is supporting law enforcement and keeping our communities safe.Far-Left extremists are hell-bent on smearing and defunding the law enforcement officers who risk their lives daily to protect our communities.Leftist politicians and Soros-backed prosecutors are enabling chaos and undermining the law enforcement profession by letting violent criminals walk free with hardly a slap on the wrist.In other states, repeat offenders are receiving unlimited “get out of jail free” cards and free rein to disrespect the rule of law.[**Reject the Left’s woke agenda – Rush in your support >>>**](https://rondesantis.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=c120876158&e=fdefed58de)The Left and their corporate media lapdogs don’t want you to see the destruction their woke agenda is inflicting on communities across the nation, so they’re doing what they do best: deflecting.My opponent has not been shy about his support for the reallocation and defunding of police departments. But unlike my opponent and the Soros-funded prosecutors whose pro-crime ideology has made once-great cities unlivable,**I’m not beholden to anyone but the people of Florida.****And as Governor, I have worked to ensure that Florida is a law-and-order state.** Supporting our law enforcement heroes, pursuing justice for victims, and keeping our communities safe are not Left vs. Right issues. They’re right vs. wrong issues – which is why I’ve been endorsed by Democrat elected officials like Palm Beach County Commissioner Dave Kerner. As a former law enforcement officer, Dave rejects those in his party – including my opponent – who have embraced the disastrous “defund the police” agenda.When I look a police officer in the eye and say, “I have your back,” I don’t just say it –**I follow through**.

As Governor, I have a responsibility to lead. But I also have the opportunity to make a difference and get things done.In Florida, we’ve led with purpose and conviction. Because of that, we’ve produced results better than anybody thought possible.
The good news is... we’re just getting started.My opponent’s extreme agenda and admiration of Soros-backed policies only fuel my resolve to fight woke tyranny and Keep Florida Free.D.C. Democrats are desperate to derail our progress and turn our great state into a crime-ridden dystopia.
That’s why your support is so important, Lavern. There’s more on the line than just celebrating a victory in November.We’re in a fight to safeguard our state.The safety of our families and our communities is on the line. We cannot sit idly by as far-Left extremists try to dismantle our way of life and trample on the rule of law.
They would love nothing more than to see Florida face the same fate as progressive jurisdictions overrun by violent crime. We cannot allow their twisted nightmare to become reality.

| Team,

Today is Indigenous Peoples’ Day, a time for us to remember and honor the past, present, and future of our Native communities and people.

In our region, these influences and contributions are fundamental to the very fabric of our state. More than 12,000 years ago, Indigenous people inhabited the land that would become Arizona, and to this day, there are 22 federally recognized tribes, and many more Native communities throughout our state.

But we also want to recognize that politically, there’s a lot of progress still to be made. We’ve made strides in recent years, but there is still much work to be done.

So while we celebrate the rich tradition, beautiful culture, and continuous contributions of Arizona’s Indigenous communities today, let’s also commit to continuing to treat these communities with dignity and respect every other day of the year.

Thank you to our Native communities for all they do for Arizona.

Sincerely,

AZ Dems

body:
This Columbus Day marks 30 days until election day! | | | |
---
| | |
# IT'S ALMOST TIME.
E-DAY IS JUST 30 DAYS
AWAY!
---
|
---
|
---
|
### **Friends,**

**Let’s celebrate! Not only Columbus Day, but the 30-day mark to Election Day. Columbus’ expedition set the domino effect which would change the entire world forever. We have a decision this November: do we do more of the same or will be bold enough to try something new and give tomorrow a different outlook?** **We live in the greatest nation on the planet and while I’m the first to acknowledge that we aren’t perfect, there is no better country that I’d rather live in and raise my family. That is why this November is so important and I know we hear this EVERY. SINGLE. ELECTION.**
---
| **But this time I mean it.**
---
|
---
| **Our country is hurting right now and it’s affecting all Americans regardless of political party, race, creed, or color. We have the resources and the resolve to solve these problems, but not if we ignore them. Our time to act is now!** **30 days to fight for a stronger dollar and lower prices. 30 days to push for more freedom and limited government. 30 days to send the message that our most vulnerable deserve greater access to prosperity and not to be slowly crushed under the burdens of a vicious cycle of poverty.** **I told you from the beginning that this wasn’t going to be an easy fight, and that I would compare it to David vs. Goliath. But we’ve continued to put up a helluva fight throughout the district. I’ve been calling every phone, attending every event, and knocking on every door possible. ** **Just as Columbus’s crew kept their faith as they floated into the unknown, I hope that you will remain by my side as we sweep District 30.**
---
| **These last thirty days will be essential in getting out our message and I’m counting on you for your continued support.**
---
| Sincerely,

subject: Debunking 40 popular political and economic myths
body:
| | | [](http://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4eee3e51086e4be9a752448fc438f750&_e=WQs3_3TN9x66w_-uk3U2_4PhoCDoLRL1boyeXeZclN-KKHIlCAws-P2SQAp9Sr7r-0NgouFht8lsSMcFysETNaoeGG7r5d9ixXcXPqDlaymjHYZMLZNTUcX_FrtYv9oB9CzfA1WAaU5Ed6CB8Vb_6CVdhy4B9a2qgu2YB_jtZq49ORwTZ4DRD6QqIsfZbu_5Orp_CjWlEsZLdhSP2LYnoM1q_H7errOyGAwTUpBHcV_lYj_GP5r-S7672nWjfXa7XVaYrUopwVs3ndUx-H0TFJ9mVccvWeX7wU26t1eyNR5J25YiyGX3xmgCkzN_PexKJmX4YGzFN8pEmolwLJyWdCWL013wnZxyIjNl1SoVoIKpP8dXT_xKzF9YezVsqIDf)
---

Fellow American,

For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called _Breaking Free_ , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

**But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.**

We've launched a rebuttal ad to his nasty, dishonest campaign that helps set the record straight, **[but I need your help expanding where it is airing on TV, Fellow American. I even wrote a book in 2008, called Breaking Free , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them. But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down. body:
Parent’s Rights Should Be Bi-Partisan | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b7a34e4c5c3e/valerie-offers-no-solutions-in-town-hall-last-night-9066681?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| | Dear Peter, Did you know that legislative support for school choice is much less bipartisan—even though it’s more popular among voters today than it’s ever been? Democrats are far more likely to vote against it, while conservatives support parent choice. I'm Courtney Geels, a nurse running to become your Congresswoman in Washington D.C., and this sounds a bit off to me. Maybe it does to you, too? The highest funded county in our district, per child, has the lowest average testing scores. **Higher funding isn't the solution.** There has to be an intervention on behalf of our students and parents and teachers! Teachers are leaving the classroom at an alarming rate due to low pay, high regulation and testing, and large class sizes. Education is the key to success in life and we can't allow this generation to fall through the cracks. And get this. Although most registered Democratic voters support school choice, Democratic Party politics have their ears open to everyone else intent on enforcing a hidden agenda within America’s schools. At an alarming rate, our public schools have become political pawns of wealthy teacher unions, leftist school officials, and radical teachers that have infiltrated the public schools to promote communist, socialist, and sexually perverted propaganda. And this is no conspiracy. It’s actually happening, folks.
---
| [ ](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=15a23a11e9&e=20ac8f046f "School Choice Shouldn’t Be a Debate– It’s a No-Brainer")
---
You shouldn't have to co-parent with the government.
| From books in libraries that promote sexual activities, including pornographic illustrations, to ELEMENTARY kids [you heard that right], to the encouragement in individual classrooms of children, young children, to define their sexual orientation...and so much more, public schools are losing trust with parents. It’s time to empower parents to have a say in what is taught in schools– that truly educating our kids with fundamental core curriculum should be the focus, not indoctrinating them with leftist ideologies. Parents deserve a choice to place their kids in an educational institution that aligns with their values, no matter their income level. This is a no-brainer. Our parents should not have to co-parent with the government. It’s time to provide better options, creating a competing marketplace which will help raise the standard of education across the board, which only benefits the students in the long run. **Early voting starts October 20th.** We can’t sit idly by. This is the future of our kids; of our nation. Get out to vote for common sense. I’m ready to get my hands dirty for the sake of our kids.
---
|
For truth, justice, and unity,

Courtney Geels

name: Herschel Walker
subject: When the Left is losing, they smear their opponents
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
The Left is desperate to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, so they came up with an “October Surprise.” We cannot let the Le |
---
Peter,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Peter, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. # Mike Ford, the Democrat Running for
US Congress in GA-09
US Army Vietnam Veteran. Lawyer for 46 years. Husband, father, grandfather.
Dedicated to defend the US Constitution, our rights, and our freedoms.
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=be18609e83&e=e60663a86e)
**Please allow me to introduce myself, I ’m Mike Ford, the Democrat running for US Congress in Georgia’s 9th Congressional District.** I’m trying to pull off an epic upset to unseat extremist Republican incumbent, Rep Andrew Clyde. As I make my way across Georgia's 9th District, I am both energized and humbled by the growing support. Georgians, particularly women and parents of daughters, are deeply and rightfully scared of unchecked Republican extremism on the march, both here in Georgia and across our nation. People of all political stripes are coming out of the woodwork to support my campaign. Democrats, Independents, and a growing number of fair-minded Republicans, keep telling me that elected Republicans have gone too far and they are ready to vote Democratic this November 8th.

I welcome everyone to join me in our collective fight to defend our democracy, restore women’s full reproductive rights and autonomy over their own bodies, protect our voting rights, protect Social Security and Medicare, and eject divisive right-wing extremism from our US House of Representatives.I would be honored to have your support and your vote.With Sincere Gratitude,
Mike Ford
[**mike4georgia.com**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=165a1cd42d&e=e60663a86e)
|
---
**A Bit About the 9th Congressional District**
After the 2020 election when Democrat Carolyn Bourdeaux won in GA-07 in Gwinnett County, Republicans in the Georgia State House redrew all the districts across the state. Their cynical goal was to gerrymander the maps in their favor, to divide and dilute the growing Democratic majority in the metro-Atlanta suburbs. **Attention Gwinnett County Residents:** As you can see in the map above, Gwinnett County is now split into three different Congressional Districts:

**Bob Christian** is the Democrat running in GA-06
**Rep Lucy McBath** is the Democrat running in GA-07
**Mike Ford** the Democrat running in GA-09If you know someone in Gwinnett County, or any of the fourteen counties listed above that are in GA-09, please forward them this email to help inform them of changes to our election maps, because knowledge is power.
|
---
**Don’t forget that tomorrow, Tuesday, October 11th, is the last day** for Georgians to register to vote in the mid-term elections. If you or someone you know is a US Citizen, 18 years or older, simply go to the Georgia Secretary of State website to register to vote and/or double-check your current voter registration status.**Early voting starts Oct 17** but hurry, check now to make sure your voter status is still valid. Talk to family, friends, neighbors, co-workers and encourage them to register. **Election Day is Tuesday, Nov 8.** We need everyone to show up to vote Democratic. Remind your family, friends, neighbors, social media network that they don’t have to be a Democrat to vote Democratic. I welcome their support and their vote.

Hi friends,

This month, and today, we celebrate and honor the cultures and histories of the Native American people by recognizing the contributions that indigenous peoples have made to our country and state – long before anyone else settled here, Native Americans were here living, learning, and raising their families.

This holiday allows us to remember and reflect on the narratives and stories we tell ourselves about our nation. Columbus Day affirms the narrative of a country created by Europeans for Europeans. Indigenous Peoples' Day helps us reflect on the stories and past of Native American communities and their place in our country.

In Wisconsin especially, the **Menominee** , **Ojibwe (Chippewa)** , **Potawatomi** , and **Ho-Chunk (Winnebago)** peoples are among the original inhabitants of our great state. Today is an important day to remember, not only to celebrate the achievements of Indigenous Peoples but also to reflect on the harmful effects of racism and colonization that have affected their communities, in violent and tragic ways.

There is still far more work we must do to right wrongs and support Indigenous and Native communities, and that is why we must keep pushing for change.

Thank you,

Despite taking credit in the press, Jack Bergman voted against rural broadband, against in-district manufacturing jobs, and against infrastructure funding for vital projects like the Soo Locks.
He opposed veteran-supported bills that work to prevent soldier suicide, and denied V.A. facility upgrades and modernization.
Bergman even voted against affordable insulin and against an emergency solution to the National baby formula shortage.

Our current Representative claims to be working for Michigan's First District, but he's only passed two sponsored bills in six years and hasn't held a town hall since 2017. He admits to living in Louisiana.
Stop inefficient, ineffective, and inaccessible government.
Jack Bergman is too extreme for Michigan, and he's working against us.
This election put people first and vote for Doctor Bob Lorinser for U.S. Congress. It's time to bring back principled leadership to Northern Michigan and the U.P.

This Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we wanted to use the opportunity to reflect on Indigenous peoples’ contributions to America and Texas in particular.

As the native people of this land, they faced violence, displacement, and disease from settlers and colonizers, and much of their stories remain untold. However, Native communities around the country continue to work tirelessly to preserve and share their history and collective memory. Their resilience is an inspiration for all of our communities. **_By recognizing this on Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we can begin to heal as a nation by celebrating our diversity._**

That is why we wanted to reach out today, team. Indigenous Peoples’ Day allows us to reflect on the contributions to Texas by Indigenous peoples and the past and current ways we have failed them. In a truly equitable society, when one group succeeds, we all do. We hope that you join us in using today to engage in self-education around the history of Indigenous people and their inspiring resilience against oppression.

Respectfully,

The A Team

Fellow American,

Last week, my campaign sent you an email to let you know that my race is tightening up as we barrel toward Election Day. It was my hope that the news about _**Politico**_ moving my race from “**likely Democrat** ” to “**lean Democrat** ” would get all of you excited.

**The response was lukewarm, to say the least.** Just 10 supporters donated to my campaign all day last Thursday.

**With just 29 days until Election Day,** that is how we lose this race – and the House majority. Fellow American, my opponent and her allies are spending more than $500,000 to attack me and slander my good name to the voters I’m asking to support me. With our race **TIED** this close to ballots going in the mail, we cannot afford to lose your support now.

Today, we need to double what we raised off last week’s email. That means before midnight tonight we need to see $2,418 in donations come through. **Are you able to chip in a couple of dollars to help me out right now?**

| [**HELP US AVOID BUDGET CUTS** **› › **](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=84abd232107a4710b93542a559083795&_e=TaYhdE3JXBQ3y5LTvWXSZcrTcnSBUeWZC6y5sggkGWBNROyB-TzX6GoaUTXLe9P5voWuWZPkgsQ1eYv3q-Rcc5AFXzT-gM3ZLnrQL5XHGyZlDXfm5XoU3ZqdpLLvS2V3b72P4u__E_rtbmR3dN8sEGPVGBdLS0iAoQaVRdD3_NGiGUV1OqQXUaVSEoQucFDJkFs2qBKomCfQzU4RKUZQD5NdlUQxGfMtbbqxevdxSLrILPTUSwG9o0hqtgqWUXWlwUdZdEbDez9kOILe7mt1HV4iFg2BpmxUqB9_myeABU2qEBZf1kRAl5L2Ov-agFyeAtoTyGU8unFFFX3VJIBhz78rKxCKj-Z7Z0uVOIosS1ICnmIcJRfDc4e85iefoAyVTezOxa_lg2fSkCla-LeyMw%3D%3D)

body:
Hi there,
If you ask my family, friends and team about me, one thing you’ll probably hear pretty quickly is that I’m a straight shooter. After years on the bench as a judge and the former Chief Justice of North Carolina, it’s just my nature.
That mindset is what I think you deserve from your next U.S. Senator, and it’s how we’ve tried to run this campaign.
From the start of this campaign, we’ve tried to be as transparent as possible because there would be no campaign without the support of folks like you. That’s why we don’t do the fake “triple matches” or scare tactics you probably see elsewhere.
I want you to know that when we ask it’s because it’s important. It’s because I know that $5 and $5at a time will make a difference.
And with our official FEC deadline coming up on the 17th, the reality is that we need to ask for a lot of help in the next week. We’ve got our most ambitious goal ever, and the honest truth is we are significantly behind on our fundraising.
So I am humbly asking you today:
Can you please split a donation of $5 or whatever you can afford between our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand today? We have to reach this goal to ensure we have the resources to fend off the dark money flooding our state. [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/beasley_gfs?refcode=jtk3674-bu-nd]

>
I’m filled with gratitude for this team. The outpouring of support has been absolutely humbling, and I hope you know that I do not make these asks lightly.
I truly believe our job is to use every dollar you give as effectively and efficiently as possible. And there are still important investments we can make today that will pay massive dividends when the votes are counted.
But with just weeks to go and the FEC deadline in a week, there is no time to waste.
So please, if you can, split a $5 donation to our campaign to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat and Kirsten Gillibrand. Anything you can spare today gets put to work immediately to help us organize in all 100 counties and get our message in front of more voters. [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/beasley_gfs?refcode=jtk3674-bu-nd]
Supporters like you are the heart of this effort, friend. And I promise that you can always count on me to call it like I see it.
- Cheri Beasley

Friend,In recent months, we have seen unprecedented attacks on our fundamental freedoms. The U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and has also agreed to hear cases that could fundamentally change our democracy. Meanwhile, gerrymandered state legislatures continue to introduce and advance voter suppression legislation.
There are many reasons why the upcoming midterms will be one of the most critical elections of our lifetime -- but the impact that state legislators can have on our way of life and the integrity of our democracy is key among them.
After serving as Attorney General of the United States during the Obama administration, I founded the National Democratic Redistricting Committee (NDRC) with the goal of ending gerrymandering and protecting voting rights. Our team has accomplished a great deal over the last few years, but our work is far from over and we remain committed to our goal. We will continue to support candidates committed to fighting gerrymandering, upholding voting rights, and protecting our democracy.
That’s why I’m asking you to donate to the Minnesota House Democrats right now. They are defenders of democracy who will support the fundamental rights the far-right is actively trying to restrict. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hdfl-oct2022?refcode=101022]
Grassroots supporters have been critical in our work to achieve fair maps. And now more than ever, we need to support Democratic candidates to ensure that we have elected officials who are committed to upholding American democracy and safeguarding voting rights.
I urge you to contribute to the Minnesota House Democrats today. They have our unwavering support. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hdfl-oct2022?refcode=101022]
We thank you for everything you do to help us.
Eric H. Holder, Jr.
82nd Attorney General of the United States
Chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee

**Now, with just a few weeks left until Election Day, polls are showing that we’re neck-and-neck with Mike DeWine – and it couldn’t be more critical that we make sure we’re helping every single voter register and get to the polls.**

Over the past year and a half – ever since we launched this campaign last year – we’ve been hard at work to help ensure that Ohioans are registered and ready to vote in this critical election. We’ve seen the results. Especially in the wake of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , record numbers of women and younger Ohioans have registered to vote and participate in our democracy. Now, with just a few weeks left until Election Day, polls are showing that we’re neck-and-neck with Mike DeWine – and it couldn’t be more critical that we make sure we’re helping every single voter register and get to the polls. = There has never been more on the line. Just hours after the Supreme Court’s decision in Dobbs , Mike DeWine and his allies enacted one of the most extreme bans on abortion in the country – a ban that just a few days ago, a judge put on hold. But we can’t count on the courts to put a stop to Governor DeWine’s extremism. We need a governor who will fight to restore and protect reproductive freedom, not cater to right-wing extremists who don’t represent what Ohioans want. Peter,

For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called _Breaking Free_ , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

**But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.**

We've launched a rebuttal ad to his nasty, dishonest campaign that helps set the record straight, **[but I need your help expanding where it is airing on TV, Peter. When Rand Paul first ran for Senate, he appeared on Fox News to make his
position on abortion as straightforward as possible:

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18736?t=1001&akid=2579%2E346206%2Eqnq-AR ][IMG]

“I will take all approaches -- state, local, and federal, to try to
prohibit abortion.”

mother, which he said is “separate from that individual life.”

Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Fellow American, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e0ed833346fc484794b412af3b5921e1&_e=NPcz5BcHsP3C6EZMJwurNUMvpoAa3cc_GbWeSgiObTkT0kpYA-2GHB2mdaEFom8hkKO36Ot8VS6QMLskj1lcdycE6zdK32ZDUTo-C6L_8A_DirPcLaSiU-euKINLgCXVNjZZd-nGkl7RFllnPdY7llMTBjfMmd3WiHe1KpXVwS7YPe5nlnqGBoy7xE5RxeFT9l67lZEeaCkJLNiCGk9n_MXIFxKceAK_NBEnDDJRMxPvvVu60eh5RZvKVDtbIbDXrqBFFDFNGU4mKgD0bwi4CHYRVAencsZFSQQefA5dbV-BqO7fV6CTfnC6y1eiCifhkBvRYDmj9wjTYojMkebcxUiHZVMg9R3sG_7KdCoDYlrRuIOVg3CwkJThC2xoJKGNvJqXnntB_9msNq8gmKMWOZCnU8zGe_eAcD5NVNIZggc%3D) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

**The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.**

**[I need your help and support now more than ever. For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called _Breaking Free_ , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

**But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.**

name: Team AOC
subject: The dangerous link between fossil fuel companies and missing and murdered Indigenous women
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
This collaboration between law enforcement and fossil fuel companies puts Indigenous women and girls at heightened risk of abduction and murder.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221010-3485-header&t=1&akid=3485%2E2526796%2EBJRemD)
On this Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we must acknowledge our country’s ongoing crisis of missing and murdered Indigenous women. Since 2016, over 5,700 Indigenous women and girls have gone missing.1
Angel Charley, Executive Director of the Coalition to Stop Violence Against Native Women, testified during a House hearing earlier this year about the**dangerous link between missing and murdered Indigenous women and fossil fuel companies.**
Fossil fuel industries bring non-local workers into what are known as ‘man camps’ or temporary settlements that often exist right outside the borderlands of Native communities. When these man camps are created, there is an increase in violence, and particularly sexual violence, against Native women. In February, two people working on the Line 3 Pipeline in Minnesota were arrested in a sex trafficking sting.2
But, many Indigenous nations do not have tribal jurisdiction over non-Native offenders, which includes the majority of these fossil fuel workers.
**That’s why Alexandria and our movement fought to urgently pass the Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act of 2022.**
The reauthorized version of the Violence Against Women Act finally allows Tribal courts to exercise jurisdiction over non-Native perpetrators of sexual assault and sex trafficking.
Charley said that the root of inaction to protect Native women “is the devaluation of Indigenous lives since the onset of colonization.”
**By expanding special criminal jurisdiction of Tribal courts to cover non-Native perpetrators, Congress has taken an actionable step toward better protecting Indigenous women and girls — but more still needs to be done.**
Today and always, our movement stands with our country’s Indigenous communities, and we will not stop fighting until we are all liberated.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

clean_body: This collaboration between law enforcement and fossil fuel companies puts Indigenous women and girls at heightened risk of abduction and murder. On this Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we must acknowledge our country’s ongoing crisis of missing and murdered Indigenous women. Since 2016, over 5,700 Indigenous women and girls have gone missing.1 Angel Charley, Executive Director of the Coalition to Stop Violence Against Native Women, testified during a House hearing earlier this year about thedangerous link between missing and murdered Indigenous women and fossil fuel companies. Fossil fuel industries bring non-local workers into what are known as ‘man camps’ or temporary settlements that often exist right outside the borderlands of Native communities. When these man camps are created, there is an increase in violence, and particularly sexual violence, against Native women. In February, two people working on the Line 3 Pipeline in Minnesota were arrested in a sex trafficking sting.2 But, many Indigenous nations do not have tribal jurisdiction over non-Native offenders, which includes the majority of these fossil fuel workers. That’s why Alexandria and our movement fought to urgently pass the Violence Against Women Reauthorization Act of 2022. The reauthorized version of the Violence Against Women Act finally allows Tribal courts to exercise jurisdiction over non-Native perpetrators of sexual assault and sex trafficking. Charley said that the root of inaction to protect Native women “is the devaluation of Indigenous lives since the onset of colonization.” By expanding special criminal jurisdiction of Tribal courts to cover non-Native perpetrators, Congress has taken an actionable step toward better protecting Indigenous women and girls — but more still needs to be done. Today and always, our movement stands with our country’s Indigenous communities, and we will not stop fighting until we are all liberated. In solidarity, Team AOC 1 - - | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZwTQ7I6Gd3isMJhBiNLWshcPV0oHCJW_3K1RcE38GPcaHA5NuegLLrrUYFIV9PI2OOM66NG9tX8mRyGnZGqWIs8n5YleibMmFFQaNvclGaFh9CclkGv1pq7pT-TzzsPpH1Njf8Qh2-6WWzUoKvtKfrN "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZx05mWY1hZNktRZzBJZknlRSrJQ1cQzWBprwsX4_iXgM4_8dKdBYkmf9yhxF7uML9YBfxQiAhs1H3JLldkDG_S0BiUvSbtx9ih9NoXSdPWZTCSJ4Xg1-bY38WuGSw7JJL0V7TRFoT-OR_GELngCvK45 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZxJzxr-1D6jU_rX4nvYIhi4NtAqTnfBpK1Ly9SVTYUoJIGMw_RmI7WKdyrIFt96Px8V1Cob_11pDTUbWJTI9c_zJt2RByhU3XCcT0u5Crn8OllaIFEBmJ9BykS4EZIN61PGudaQPQ8W-s9JbwWSm8AB "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZw4pB7cdbKeHgsYixAAtbjxAPmI_R6h81N2A6njJanAj-LvmGGzpK44UaHKR3WM3LM7hDTk6DAwO5hk0wzuAqsmfKUYh1LkgQeTPsNM6zHfAxHHlUt57qQnN6wYyFIZ9PwjaO9YmwCYyp9ywHZg450T "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZxGJvZj_fdLloNl2o43qbA_jYWZJCcgmCSSBGKuuw0yZimilpnBA-H6O5P5B5K4vQ36epxLD84N2ipnshZgxNPII0sWbUfhWww28H3ACIUSp1o5pFuftLf2LCr5C9U8JWRFH8xL5Y7kK-pCwOqLMC3V "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZwzo_Z8iAdNL8ma-P_HvXCjGXoXmgz3VPV4kn-4m2OhlpB4X8-5I_aNOCSJe6YlYfKDH-wElQnYOlbApCy3gEGpRcz5u0MZ8Rz2RInE-m-Lh3PLevZWWejgVVmoRt_RZLvQg4wMqPA6jZqPpsbUN8rU "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way— _and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZwad2Rek-Aa5hvMtsp3iuFuXTSQjpufA6HXzU4DvSoyx-E-GOKTDFlNBPqfbgLZZ1_a8xz7gU6EzHop2F6_wpgKTAMAf7oGBRFKh0OLZ7QYieGJtPoXB52jl83tyeIKo0JpGnBJWAX0fj4aKNF2w9Gv "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=349057efcc8843f6bda34b9d8ff3af2e&_e=Wvc2iCouiiCSSorcGBQsqwEDJDTvZ-1QTDG-IvhzwudA2eafXpxsN_97Wlrmshyn4jal9obOjYN6iJWikFX0CgL0-i_utVN4A6aoLEvfJFSoo7VxIX8m_9Q6Ta0QzDYdk1V26IMcgvsqE0QdY_GBbeXTFtw6nMSuQXx6gctvKO7-OU3JzSmnp8NSra7t8a4TIU6n8L5_GQ-dM2G7CT3rTIRVedEHKEfCGzSlMX8Oct0-7FDHxtep23FeDeoiE6LjZ5BiqCvCgiXGNpzF6V0vadlvSrxCLzSieP3v012XfZyDn5k3smuEaGIIEzWf4OmuPmaGqw4h93s2Zm3OnCP7ILqvXZps2RcpirAVKWRrBS4ukMSsoDKeQX-UxotOFcIqmnfvkFGeeSpdHv5xn7XFwAPjDvLEvdr_TrleboXwoTsAZ__hpB-hGv1RfbHGhVaC "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

Peter,

For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder.

I even wrote a book in 2008, called _Breaking Free_ , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them.

**But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down.**

We've launched a rebuttal ad to his nasty, dishonest campaign that helps set the record straight, **[but I need your help expanding where it is airing on TV, Peter. #

It’s a special day here on Team Beasley. Stanley, our founding furry member, is turning 5 today!
[](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221010-2-MA&t=1&akid=1989%2E357359%2E_OJb08)
Stanley Beasley joined the family as a puppy, and every morning when Cheri got up to serve the people of North Carolina as Chief Justice, he was with her ready to help his mom in her relentless pursuit of justice.
Stanley knows how important it is that everyone’s voice is heard in our state. That’s why he’s always ready to bark up for the most important issues — like climate change to make sure everyone has access to clean air and water, lower costs so no food bowl goes empty, voting rights so everybody’s bark is heard at the ballot box, and high quality belly rubs.
Stanley knows we can all trust his mom to speak up for the people (and pets!) of our state in the U.S. Senate.
And with less than 30 days until Election Day, he knows the belly rubs will have to wait. So instead of asking for treats for himself today, he’s hoping you’ll do something special for his mom.

name: Martin Sheen
subject: I had to reach out about Donald Trump's rally
body:
Derek - I write to you today, not as an actor or a former (fictional) president, but as an American concerned about losing our Democratic Senate majority: Donald Trump just left Nevada where he held a MAGA rally to defeat Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto (D) in the race that will decide Senate control.
If Trump tips the scales in favor of his hand-picked extremist, Adam Laxalt (R)– if they defeat Sen. Cortez Masto – then Democrats will lose the Senate and Mitch McConnell will regain his iron grip on power.
I refuse to sit on the sidelines and watch our country return to dark days where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies and where the selfish interests of deranged extremists reign supreme. That's why I need you to join me in fighting back against Trump and helping Sen. Cortez Masto protect this seat and our majority.
I’m personally asking you: Will you split $25 between Catherine’s campaign and CommonGood to combat Trump's attacks, keep Nevada blue and defend our Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM&amount=25]
I've been an activist my entire life, Derek. I've witnessed moments where people came together by the thousands, by the millions, to usher in great progress for this nation.
But I've also seen the consequences when not enough people rise to the urgency of the moment before them – and right now I can say to you with confidence that we've never faced a more urgent, a more important, midterm election.
If Republicans flip the one seat they need to retake control – if they flip this seat – they will usher in an era of zero bodily autonomy for women, of further attacks on voting and free and fair elections, of turning a blind eye to climate change. They will roll out the red carpet for the return of the impeached former president.
It's why Donald Trump himself flew all the way to Nevada to hold one of his infamous, dangerous MAGA rallies: to defeat Catherine Cortez Masto and begin his return to power. We must do everything we can to stop him, and that means ensuring Catherine has the resources to fight back and win.
Please, split a contribution of $25 or whatever you can spare to fight back against Trump, help Catherine Cortez Masto win in Nevada and protect our Democratic Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20221010_CGVA_CCM]
Thank you,
Martin Sheen

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578355:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
Peter ,, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61578356:6icEFqVdN:m:1:3360412034:DBBDFA6316C93ADFBB21E0EDA62CD48E:r "Rush support now to be a part of

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221010&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221010&amount=28]
Team,
My district is a unique place. Both the 8th district, which I currently represent, and the new 7th district, where I’m running, have always been independently-minded. It’s one of the only places in the country where people still vote for the person over the party. Case in point: I'm the only Democrat still left in the House who won a district that went for Romney in 2012, Trump in 2016, and Trump again in 2020.
Over the years, I’ve heard quite a few stories of Democrats quietly finding each other through our campaign – especially in the new, more conservative areas of the new 7th.
Case in point: the bumper sticker the Clinton County Democratic Party sells at their events. It reflects something that Washington often misses: that it’s often hard to be a Democrat in a conservative place.
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221010&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221010&amount=28]
In addition, we know of at least two fake book clubs that have formed over the years. Women tell their Republican husbands they’re going to a book club, and then secretly come volunteer for our campaign. And, I’ve had more folks than I can count tell me that after years of voting Republican, I’ve been their gateway into Democratic politics.
In these places, tangible expressions of support like yard signs are critical. People frequently come up to me to say that they were nervous to put up their yard sign, because they had assumed they were the only Democrat in their neighborhood. Then, not long after their sign went up, more and more slowly started to pop up along their street. We even know of friendships that started when neighbors “came out” to each other as Democrats by checking out each other's signs.
It’s thanks to a lot of these folks that I’m able to serve in Congress, and that Democrats have a razor-thin majority in Congress. And it just goes to show how powerful finding a community of like-minded people can be – even if you don’t think it exists.
So, talk to your neighbors. They might surprise you. And if you’d like to help me continue to serve this independently-minded district, consider making a contribution below. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221010&amount=28]

subject: Indigenous People's Day 2022
body:
Today we celebrate and uplift the lives, cultures, and contributions of Indigenous peoples. | | | Hello friends!
Indigenous People's Day represents years of organizing and advocacy to rectify the whitewashing of U.S. history. It's also a day to celebrate our traditions and lifeways culturally, economically, and politically. In 2019, 7 Directions of Service launched our cultural education, starting with the first-ever Indigenous People's Day event in Saxapahaw, NC. We're working hard to get out in the community to organize and empower frontline communities with our Southeast Indigenous Teach-ins and community events. By mobilizing our indigenous and afro indigenous communities, we can continue to build a future where Indigenous rights are respected and represented. You can help us in this vital work by donating today. subject: What President Biden just did on marijuana (and why every governor should follow suit)
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JAY INSLEE FOR WASHINGTON (D)
body:
No one should be held back in life because of a marijuana possession conviction.

| [](https://links.e.jayinslee.com/els/v2/yr7KJKy492SZ/bmt0cFZsUHBuQXBOdzB5bkNOQWlsNDlFbU00RXZlajRVWUtKbDVBU1J4OVc2c1hsM0p3VTNrdFRVMllEZm0wYi9aWm93TmFCT0FQVURxWjBnWVpZekcxckZidFpTdzJhakxOb1J4MmxGK0E9S0/Z21IdzZ3MjFFQUY0b1NrN3h0Z2ZXcERJSjNwcXZwZGVoVllaS3RPUGZyWT0S1) | Friend, will you sign our petition urging my fellow governors to join me and President Biden in pardoning fellow Americans with marijuana possession convictions?
---
| [SIGN YOUR NAME](https://links.e.jayinslee.com/els/v2/D_r2c_w6DNh2/bmt0cFZsUHBuQXBOdzB5bkNOQWlsNDlFbU00RXZlajRVWUtKbDVBU1J4OVc2c1hsM0p3VTNrdFRVMllEZm0wYi9aWm93TmFCT0FQVURxWjBnWVpZekcxckZidFpTdzJhakxOb1J4MmxGK0E9S0/Z21IdzZ3MjFFQUY0b1NrN3h0Z2ZXcERJSjNwcXZwZGVoVllaS3RPUGZyWT0S1)
---
Back in 2019, I was proud to be the first governor in the country to pardon thousands of Washingtonians previously convicted of marijuana possession.
So I was thrilled to see President Biden's recent announcement pardoning thousands of people with federal convictions for marijuana possession. And I couldn't agree more with the president's decision. Every governor across the country should follow suit.
[**_Let 's make sure America's governors are hearing our call: Join me in urging my fellow governors to follow our lead, and President Biden's example, by pardoning citizens with marijuana convictions._**](https://links.e.jayinslee.com/els/v2/V4dzSx7aGjQp/bmt0cFZsUHBuQXBOdzB5bkNOQWlsNDlFbU00RXZlajRVWUtKbDVBU1J4OVc2c1hsM0p3VTNrdFRVMllEZm0wYi9aWm93TmFCT0FQVURxWjBnWVpZekcxckZidFpTdzJhakxOb1J4MmxGK0E9S0/Z21IdzZ3MjFFQUY0b1NrN3h0Z2ZXcERJSjNwcXZwZGVoVllaS3RPUGZyWT0S1)
This is a step in correcting the injustices caused by marijuana laws, particularly in communities of color. But without states taking measures to initiate pardons on their own, the president's impact will be limited.
Archaic marijuana laws make it harder for convicted individuals to live their lives. Their convictions make it harder to find housing, to find a job, to play a productive role in our communities.
**It 's time for other governors to follow President Biden and Washington state's lead and take measures to remedy the effects of these unjust laws.**
[**_Sign your name to show how unjust and discriminatory marijuana laws are and urge other governors to take action._**](https://links.e.jayinslee.com/els/v2/V4dzSx7aGjQp/bmt0cFZsUHBuQXBOdzB5bkNOQWlsNDlFbU00RXZlajRVWUtKbDVBU1J4OVc2c1hsM0p3VTNrdFRVMllEZm0wYi9aWm93TmFCT0FQVURxWjBnWVpZekcxckZidFpTdzJhakxOb1J4MmxGK0E9S0/Z21IdzZ3MjFFQUY0b1NrN3h0Z2ZXcERJSjNwcXZwZGVoVllaS3RPUGZyWT0S1)
Very truly yours,
Jay

clean_body: No one should be held back in life because of a marijuana possession conviction. | | Friend, will you sign our petition urging my fellow governors to join me and President Biden in pardoning fellow Americans with marijuana possession convictions? | Back in 2019, I was proud to be the first governor in the country to pardon thousands of Washingtonians previously convicted of marijuana possession. So I was thrilled to see President Biden's recent announcement pardoning thousands of people with federal convictions for marijuana possession. And I couldn't agree more with the president's decision. Every governor across the country should follow suit. This is a step in correcting the injustices caused by marijuana laws, particularly in communities of color. But without states taking measures to initiate pardons on their own, the president's impact will be limited. Archaic marijuana laws make it harder for convicted individuals to live their lives. Their convictions make it harder to find housing, to find a job, to play a productive role in our communities. It 's time for other governors to follow President Biden and Washington state's lead and take measures to remedy the effects of these unjust laws. Very truly yours, Jay

Hi friend, Happy Columbus or Indigenous People's Day! I know that the State of California, and many private businesses, do not observe today as a holiday, but if you do, this is a really good day to vote! Many voters have already received their ballots (I have not), and they should all be arriving in the next few days. So, keep a look-out, and make sure you don't just keep "putting it off" by voting early. It's also a good day to talk to neighbors, who likewise have the day off, and remind them to vote! Our district (and state) had terrible turnout in the June Primary Election (both Republican and Democrat). Voting is important -- especially when so much is on the line like this year.
