body:
We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice.
| Friends -

I am writing to ask you to make a $7 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. I hope you will give me a moment to explain why your contribution is so important to his campaign.

Mandela is running to defeat Republican incumbent Ron Johnson, one of the most reactionary and self-serving members of the U.S. Senate. **A recent poll shows this race is tied, and Mandela is up against some very powerful special interests who are spending obscene amounts of money to try to defeat him.**

So Mandela needs your help, especially before his FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month.

Ron Johnson is someone who relies on corporate interests to fund his campaign. But Mandela is funding his campaign the right way – from lots of people making small donations.

That is the only way he is going to have the resources to win this race, and that is why I need to ask:

[Can you please split a $7 contribution between Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and Voter Protection Project? As long as we are in this together, we are going to send Mandela to the Senate and expand the majority.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28941?t=6&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Mandela Barnes and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28989?t=7&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28943?t=8&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28944?t=9&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28945?t=10&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28946?t=11&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
At this moment in American history — in the midst of massive income and wealth inequality, a global pandemic, and the existential threat of climate change — it has never been more important to elect candidates like Mandela who will fight for the working class of this country.

We need to elect more candidates who will take on corporate greed, authoritarianism, and bigotry and who are prepared to fight for justice. In order to do that, we must bring our people together in a multi-generational, multi-racial movement to take on the big-money interests that have so much political and economic power in our country.

Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign in Wisconsin. And if he wins in November, he will continue our struggle for justice in the U.S. Senate.

First, we need to come together to defeat a Republican extremist who denies the reality of climate change, participated in a scheme to overturn the 2020 election results, and has repeatedly sided with corporate interests at the expense of working people.

But this Wisconsin Senate race isn't just about replacing Ron Johnson. It's also about expanding the Senate majority so we can finally have the votes to pass meaningful legislation to address the many crises we face.

Mandela Barnes is in a very close race right now, and he is relying on grassroots support in order to fund his campaign between now and Election Day. So I am asking you one more time:

[Please split a $7 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and Voter Protection Project. He is rejecting all corporate PAC money, and your contribution today will ensure he has the financial resources to flip this seat.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28941?t=12&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Mandela Barnes and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28989?t=13&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28943?t=14&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28944?t=15&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28945?t=16&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28946?t=17&akid=4855%2E878179%2EMc6TBz)
We are engaged in many struggles right now. We are trying to save the planet from the ravages of climate change. We're trying to create an economy that works for all and not just the billionaire class. We're trying to defend our democracy against those who are moving us toward authoritarianism. And that's just to name a few.

But, in the midst of all these struggles, we cannot simply remain on the defensive. We need to continue building our movement to transform this country.

That means standing with candidates like Mandela Barnes who will take on powerful special interests. Thank you for adding a contribution to his campaign today.

In solidarity,

Bernie Sanders

Derek, Brian Kemp

Peter**,** Let me set the record straight.

I fought for our country for over 25 years in Somalia, Afghanistan, and Iraq and now I’m being called an “extremist” for believing in fiscally conservative policies and energy independence.

Mandela is a candidate who will have the guts to take on powerful special interests and challenge the status quo if elected to the Senate.
He is the son of a Milwaukee public school teacher and a UAW assembly line worker. Both of his parents were active union members who organized for better wages, benefits and working conditions.
From a very young age, Mandela saw the power of grassroots organizing and what is possible when people come together to challenge the status quo. It's what led him to run for state representative, and then for Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin.
As Lieutenant Governor he has led efforts across the state to address the climate crisis, and enable Wisconsin to respond effectively to the COVID pandemic. Now Mandela is running for Senate because he believes that it's time to prioritize the needs of working people and take on powerful special interests.
Let’s be clear. We are living in a time where the 1% is doing phenomenally well, while working people are falling further and further behind. Now is the time to stand up and fight back, and Mandela will be an important ally in that struggle.
The November midterm elections are enormously important. They will determine whether we go forward fighting for the long-neglected needs of working families, or continue the drift toward oligarchy and authoritarianism.
Mandela is counting on strong grassroots support in order to fund his campaign during these critical final weeks before the election. So I am asking:
[Can you please split a $10 contribution between Mandela Barnes' campaign for Senate and The Collective PAC today? Peter,

subject: My daughter was shot and killed in Parkland, four years ago. Since then, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have worked to end gun background check protections. State legislative candidates like Rachel Baker are our first defense against dangerous criminals buying all the guns they want, and your support can make a real difference in a race like this.

| | | | | Peter, in a moment, I'm going to ask you to join me in helping Rachel Baker defeat Jenn Giroux, in what is Ohio's most important state legislative race--perhaps one of the most important in the country. **_Four years ago, my daughter Jaime was murdered with an assault weapon in the Parkland massacre. Ever since, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have not only done almost nothing to solve a problem, but, in fact, they've passed legislation in Ohio and other states to allow any criminal or terrorist to carry concealed weapons of war in our streets, by eliminating background checks._** We've seen the results in Uvalde, Buffalo, Highland Park, and in 2019, the Oregon, District of Dayton, Ohio, when nine people out for a fun night on the town were murdered, and 17 others sent to local hospitals with their lives never to be the same. [**This is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8ee97b7f-2df2-40f6-a366-97ecebda5fcf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **After the awful Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v Wade, Giroux also came out against abortion in all cases--making the ridiculous claim that women never have to choose between their lives and having an abortion. Giroux's combination of extremism and ignorance are both astounding and dangerous. **

body:
Join us this week for events and door knocking! | | | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

We had another great week of hosting events, knocking doors, and talking to the people of West Michigan. We extend a huge "Thank you!" to all of our volunteers who knocked doors and walked with us in the Pulaski Days parade this past weekend.

**We are just 4 weeks** **away**. Conservative candidates all across Michigan need your continued support to secure victory on November 8th. Let's keep radical-left Democrats like Hillary Scholten out of office. Now is the time to join the movement!

There's a lot you can do! Please see **'Upcoming Events'** below for more details on how to get involved with events, door knocking, and phone banking.

Sincerely,

Team Gibbs
---
|
---
|
---
| **_Notice_** **Door-to-door**
Are you looking to knock doors for John Gibbs in your neighborhood? Are you a precinct delegate? Send us an email at [team@votejohngibbs.com](mailto:team@votejohngibbs.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20knock%20doors%20for%20John%20Gibbs!&body=Name%3A%20%0APrecinct%20or%20Address%3A%0APhone%20Number%3A%0A) and we will get you set up with training, campaign literature, and walk-lists. RSVP for door knocking this week in 'Upcoming Events' below.
**Yard Signs**
Please keep your yards signs up! We need to continue to show our district's support for this movement. We're excited to see even more John Gibbs for Congress yard signs up for the general election on November 8th!

name: Herschel Walker
subject: Lie, cheat, and steal
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
The Left is desperate to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, so they came up with an “October Surprise.” We cannot let the Le |
---
Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Fellow American, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=db2f40589e594b9bbe84c36b781d959c&_e=NdqBGPZS-YBEV3FsQwQFRddgj27DeoF7hQ9XPoWO41-c5ilXiTSzHgFKx6p5fJWj6M6o2RyE2zO9BusuLjo68te9MGUz7KKIagARhDNm7WPBa9B-km6fCw3CsT89eo35GKj94q4zvB0JnmqNLxLb3i902PdaIeDzkBkikBxrztzloEWd1h1WEjNbNg_Kx91SBgj65HH08cL9-7a6An5dLyItC9MuKt9XUiGJKe7St3xyRKUPWELpKMdrkAGQAsVZbm0ccYsu1UXNMqRZgemzTXojOR9iPxS0KcgGU7vZuEvkZ6lOmO5GLlAzU1ZDxpMCb-JHlmOosU6yYWFFa59GGU-VfZnD4P8Pr4FrmOCRRnApvEawWV-48TsGg0QwlQ_Hhoa0vUlzKMAAEJM4i27OHA%3D%3D) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

**The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.**

**[I need your help and support now more than ever. Last week, the _New York Times_ [published an analysis](https://substack.com/redirect/9136b219-6a7b-4a1d-9246-578b545f87a7?r=1hvr60) by columnist Megan Stack reminding many observers of one persistent factor ensuring corruption in Washington: the revolving door between politics and corporate law firms shamelessly dedicated to promoting Wall Street interests over those of the public.
Just days later, the Guardian published an analysis by human rights lawyer and former political prisoner Steven Donziger explaining [Moore v Harper](https://substack.com/redirect/0c471123-675c-4f15-98d3-15a8d8d6fd51?r=1hvr60), a particular case before the Supreme Court poised to undermine our democracy even more directly.
Each of these articles examine remarkable threats to our democracy more or less ignored by the media establishment. Equally overlooked by contemporary media sources are the [litany](https://substack.com/redirect/538cc449-fa6e-4711-af68-fdd58b77cb4b?r=1hvr60) of [historical](https://substack.com/redirect/bb1b4e5a-d156-4f23-ae99-0cf0dddb71dd?r=1hvr60) crimes [underlying](https://substack.com/redirect/3c5401dd-e934-4ad7-99ba-0b26c49c19b3?r=1hvr60) today's distribution of [capital](https://substack.com/redirect/5aa74da7-17f4-4b4b-9155-53b51e6b41a1?r=1hvr60) and power.
Indigenous People's Day not only commemorates the communities that survive and endure the continuing legacy of murderous genocide. It should also offer a reminder that these analyses of discrete vectors of corruption are, if anything, under inclusive.
Many Americans increasingly fear a fascist future. Today's holiday carries a poignant message: fascism has thrived in the United States for four hundred years.
[photo credit: Joe Wolf]
### The _New York Times_ acknowledges bipartisan corruption
Stack's column in the _New York Times_ stretches well beyond the predictable arc of critiquing corruption among former Trump officials who have, since leaving Washington, found themselves representing the same companies whose interests they promoted as corrupt self-serving lackeys in government.
Impressively, Stack reaches beyond the obvious low-hanging fruit to address an elephant--and donkey--in the room: the _bipartisan_ nature of the sordid revolving door in Washington, and its disturbingly pervasive support among Democrats, including those from the Clinton, Obama, and Biden administrations.
The first former official named in the article is the former CIA Director, who Trump promoted to the position after engineering the destruction of evidence of the CIA's criminal trail during the era when, according to President Obama, "we tortured some folks." Despite not wielding a law degree, and needing to legitimately fear detention in any foreign country as an international war criminal, [Gina Haspel now works at the law firm King & Spalding](https://substack.com/redirect/00ecdd10-96c9-4293-8824-ef07f6556462?r=1hvr60) and helps lead the firm's government affairs, national security, and corporate espionage practices.
Former officials guilty of international human rights offenses--from each of the corporate political parties--have often found plush positions in private industry. Their work in private practice undermining the public interest has served many patrons, from corporate weapons contractors and fossil fuel plunderers, to foreign governments with continuing histories of human rights abuses, as well as any number of (legitimate or not) interests connected to their former agencies.
While Stack's article thankfully notes how this pattern infects both major parties in Washington, it overlooks the _institutional_ corruption enabled by impunity for individuals who commit crimes while in office. Failing to hold accountable individual officials ultimately encourages their agencies to continue and extend their crimes against the public.
That's how indefinite detention without charge or trial, and unconstitutional mass surveillance, have survived two decades and four presidential administrations. That's why mass slavery-via-incarceration has survived for over a century and a half, despite representing in plain sight the industrial slavery that hundreds of millions of Americans have been brainwashed to falsely believe our nation repudiated after the Civil War.
Years before ever running for office, I asked one of those officials--former Director of National Intelligence James Clapper--a question after the conclusion of a 2015 Senate hearing. It was [a constitutionally protected act of journalism](https://substack.com/redirect/1bc8fad0-b0fc-417a-b873-bb8105aac069?r=1hvr60) for which I was detained and arrested, while Clapper walked out of the room with an entourage and a public pension despite lying to Congress under oath about the very subject suppressed by the New York Times and its editors 10 years earlier. (More on that below)
History is said not to repeat itself precisely, but very much to rhyme. The exposure of long-standing corruption that I have challenged for 20 years offers one particularly compelling example.
### What the Times overlooks
Despite her insightful analysis and impressively bipartisan critique, even Stack conveniently ignores the unique role played by the _Times_ in the saga she exposes. Far more than most publications, the _New York Times_ is a reliable cheerleader for the very same bipartisan institutional corruption that it bemoans this week.
Paid subscribers will see below a reminder of how the _Times_ previously swung a presidential election two decades ago, playing a critical role in accelerating the descent into fascism by enabling authoritarian policies despite their emphatic rejection at the ballot box mere months before.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..4TPksyYUq1wTU5KqPn0NT-Isyfb3h7Y7-d67EBKhXec?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=77636198)
While the press is supposed to serve as a fourth branch of government helping to guard democracy by ensuring transparency, the saga that I recap below exposes the _Times_ stooping to the level of serving government censors with the outrageously stated purpose of undermining electoral accountability.
Beyond the _Times_ , the co-optation of the nation's leading newspapers renders the government officials who silence them effectively unaccountable. But even beyond those officials, this pattern of deference to authority enables policy decisions that could never survive a transparent, open debate.
From surveillance & war for profit, to congressional insider trading, and the revolving door between agencies and Wall Street law firms, any number of corrupt practices survive because press outlets refuse to cover what the Times reflexively and self-servingly describes as "all the news that's fit to print."
That is all simply to say that corporate media (and franky, even many outlets that claim to be "independent") sources continue to threaten our Republic as much as armed vigilantes storming the Capitol. Unfortunately, I've encountered that pattern personally.
The reason I've been [waging a lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/5bb74e3e-cc69-459c-88c1-c1d71f2b5791?r=1hvr60) for the past year and a half against the Hearst Corporation is precisely because racist election disinformation published by the _San Francisco Chronicle_ offends not only its subjects, but also undermines democracy while reinforcing open, unapologetic corruption. While the _Chronicle_ has stooped lower than most publications in its defense of the establishment, its suspension of ethics and accuracy to serve capital is unfortunately emblematic of a far wider pattern.
That pattern unfortunately stretches far beyond the press. It infects the very institutions created to safeguard our Republic.
### The right wing Supreme Court turns its sights on democracy
Human rights lawyer Stephen Donziger stands among our nation's most prolific recent political prisoners. He was subjected to house arrest for [nearly three years](https://substack.com/redirect/d5a215d3-a8e2-493a-870d-6eb9a210072b?r=1hvr60) following a prosecution by a private law firm after winning a nearly $10 billion judgment from Ecuadorian courts against Chevron on behalf of several indigenous tribes in Ecuador.
Donziger wrote [an analysis](https://substack.com/redirect/e9302d5b-2583-4cdd-b7ec-96932b890449?r=1hvr60) last week of a case pending before the Supreme Court in its Term that began last week. [Moore v Harper](https://substack.com/redirect/805d0f38-5587-4782-85a2-313aca5f1fc2?r=1hvr60) presents a question that could effectively close the door on electoral democracy altogether: whether the processes set up by state legislatures to govern elections are subject to judicial review at all.
Donziger emphasizes that the U.S. Supreme Court chooses which cases to address, leaving the vast majority of petitions seeking court review unheard. The Independent State Legislature theory presented by the case has been a fringe idea in the past, so much so that it could not have reached the Court before now.
But the decision by the Court's conservative majority to hear this case in the first place indicates its likely outcome. If the conservative Justices rule with the same proclivity for judicial activism that they have embraced in the past, their decision would reverse centuries of precedent and invite state legislatures to rig elections within their states.
Should the Court ultimately decide that neither state nor federal courts are empowered to oversee the decisions of state legislatures--even when they effectively predetermine the outcome of elections--the electoral process would descend into the kind of farce that has grown routine in authoritarian countries, where countries go through the exercise of voting for alternatives that are in entrenched long before Election Day.
For the past two years, Democrats in Congress have wrung their hands and whined about the threat to our Republic posed by a potential autocrat, particularly the figure of a recent president with a shamelessly criminal past. Two major faults underlie this narrative.
First, Trump was insulated by the leaders of both political parties in Washington. That was much of why I ran to replace Pelosi: I pay too much attention to fall for the ruse that she and her party present, and remain painfully aware of how much the Democrats did to empower him when it mattered, from [recruiting](https://substack.com/redirect/fd2d6b38-819e-42b3-b129-fcd6610c670e?r=1hvr60) him to run in 2016 in the first place, to [promoting](https://substack.com/redirect/4cec6341-8631-4632-917b-466337f74e58?r=1hvr60) him within the field of GOP candidates during a contested primary, to [funding](https://substack.com/redirect/81b44a77-1d6c-4bdc-88c5-a424d69ea08c?r=1hvr60) his concentration camps without protections for human rights, taking the strongest impeachment charges [off the table](https://substack.com/redirect/a2779718-183f-475b-b8d0-b8047b60d618?r=1hvr60) to accommodate Pelosi's corruption, and more.
Second, and even more revealing, is the simple fact that authoritarianism in the United States is a longstanding phenomenon, and elections have been reduced to largely theatrical exercises for at least the past hundred years. The greatest threats to our Republic are neither new, nor do they loom in the future.
Whatever pretense of democracy in America one may have ever maintained was a farce from the beginning. In a country dedicated originally to the exclusion of property owners, women, and Black people from the voting franchise, Indigenous Peoples Day offers a reflection not of the unfortunate aberration, but instead the disturbing rule.
### Indigenous Peoples Day should remind us of America's brutally fascist past
Hitler and his Nazi followers found America's racial history [too brutal](https://substack.com/redirect/fd9aca17-c1ce-4c14-8637-e5104ee73ce5?r=1hvr60) to precisely emulate, so they pursued a less vicious program of racial destruction. The Holocaust in Europe left a shameful legacy including millions of murders, forced migration and labor, and shattered families and entire cultures.
The North American genocide was objectively worse: it was so heinous that it depleted part of the human gene pool, destroying multiple civilizations in its conquest of a continent while leaving precious little in its wake.
The genocide of indigenous north Americans across their dozens of tribal communities was not isolated to a human genocide, but rather the gateway to an ongoing ecocide that continues to this day.
Around the world, activists are clamoring to address a mounting global climate catastrophe predicated on fundamental commitments that the United States has never seen fit to revisit: the sanctity of private property, the right of capitalist to extract natural resources that they can neither produce nor replace to enrich themselves at the cost of the future, patterns of what economists describe as "internalized externalities" that consistently reveal the free hand of the market to be a little more than an rent-seeking corporate fist, and the co-optation of legions of people in their own ultimate marginalization, pitting human beings against life on Earth in the service of their own comfort and leisure.
I've written elsewhere about how [Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. warned America](https://substack.com/redirect/43b1c16d-d400-4ef3-811a-84d88af61ca6?r=1hvr60) about the precursors of the climate catastrophe well before it revealed itself, and how the entire world today pays the price of Americans choosing to ignore his message while lionizing his figure and reducing him to an amusement park attraction.
Indigenous people have offered the same warning for even longer, standing as the canaries in the coal mine of America's fascist expansion long before anyone recognize the profound costs are implicit in, for example, removing stewards of forests who had for millennia prevented the kinds of devastating wildfires that now routinely ravage states from Colorado to California every year.
Indigenous peoples day should be a poignant reminder of the failure of the American experiment, the vast divergence between our lofty rhetoric and fascist reality, and the ultimate and that awaits us if we fail to shrug off it's yolk: continuing mass extinction leaving earth a barron, lifeless, poisoned rock spinning wild hurtling through space.
Want to learn the story of how the New York Times helped pave the road to a fascist future by allowing government censors to hide information from the public with a specific intention of subverting electoral accountability? Read on......

body:
Less than one month to Election Day! Here's what you need to know... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/39fb2beea6f6/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13689316?e=00028e5542)
---
Good afternoon,I hope you are all doing well. We’re less than a month to Election Day and things have never been so promising for a win this November. Just to bring you all up to speed, here are a few quick updates related to the campaign.
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=a3d0519b8b&e=00028e5542)
**Hurricane Ian** In the aftermath of Hurricane Ian, we temporarily suspended the campaign to help with maritime search-and-rescue operations in Southwest Florida. During the extensive operations, our team of volunteers made more than 40 civilian rescues, saving people who were trapped in the wreckage of the storm and earning international media attention, including the front page of the Sunday edition of the _New York Times_.I served as the group’s lead boat captain and also aided with search-and-rescues on the ground in Sanibel Island, St. James City, Pine Island, Matlacha, Captiva and more. Additionally, we didn’t just rescue people. We also helped to rescue more than 250 parrots from a bird sanctuary, two lemurs and several dogs and cats.In one case, we established radio communications with a U.S. Coast Guard helicopter to help coordinate the medical evacuation of stranded residents from Sanibel Island. As that was happening, another helicopter flew over to my boat and signaled that a nearby boat full of rescuers was also in distress. We raced to that boat, towed them safely back to shore, and provided them with a spare anchor. We then returned to the other rescue. See the Associated Press’s story about our rescues [here](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=976f2c5b9d&e=00028e5542).The campaign has now resumed, but please continue to support and pray for our neighbors in SWFL.
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=56dfb2d101&e=00028e5542)
**We won our first general election straw poll** Here’s some promising news! The straw poll conducted by the Riverview Chamber of Commerce shows me leading Democrat incumbent Kathy Castor by nearly five points. In the poll, we led by a margin of 52.63 percent to 47.37 percent.The poll accurately reflects other predicted similar poll results in two other Florida statewide races. It shows Sen. Marco Rubio (R-FL) leading Rep. Val Demmings (D-FL) in the state’s U.S. Senate race, with Rubio ahead by a margin of 51.28 percent to Demings’s 46.15 percent.The Riverview Chamber poll also shows Republican Laurel Lee handily beating her Democrat opponent in Florida’s 15th Congressional District, as expected.
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=6dd53f538e&e=00028e5542)
**Kathy Castor Agrees to Debate** Last week at a community forum in St. Petersburg, Castor verbally agreed to participate in a debate with me. She said she would be happy to debate anytime, however, so far Castor has not followed through with her promise.After telling our campaign to call her office to schedule the debate, her team has not returned our calls for a debate.
# I STILL NEED YOUR HELP!
As the election environment continues to improve, and our chances of winning look more promising, please consider helping my campaign by making a contribution, volunteering or by placing a sign in your yard. We need money to get the word out. Please help today!
| [DONATE NOW](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=0f1cb584a8&e=00028e5542)

clean_body: Less than one month to Election Day! Here's what you need to know... | | | Good afternoon,I hope you are all doing well. We’re less than a month to Election Day and things have never been so promising for a win this November. Just to bring you all up to speed, here are a few quick updates related to the campaign. Hurricane Ian In the aftermath of Hurricane Ian, we temporarily suspended the campaign to help with maritime search-and-rescue operations in Southwest Florida. During the extensive operations, our team of volunteers made more than 40 civilian rescues, saving people who were trapped in the wreckage of the storm and earning international media attention, including the front page of the Sunday edition of the New York Times.I served as the group’s lead boat captain and also aided with search-and-rescues on the ground in Sanibel Island, St. James City, Pine Island, Matlacha, Captiva and more. Additionally, we didn’t just rescue people. We also helped to rescue more than 250 parrots from a bird sanctuary, two lemurs and several dogs and cats.In one case, we established radio communications with a U.S. Coast Guard helicopter to help coordinate the medical evacuation of stranded residents from Sanibel Island. As that was happening, another helicopter flew over to my boat and signaled that a nearby boat full of rescuers was also in distress. We raced to that boat, towed them safely back to shore, and provided them with a spare anchor. We then returned to the other rescue. See the Associated Press’s story about our rescues campaign has now resumed, but please continue to support and pray for our neighbors in SWFL. We won our first general election straw poll Here’s some promising news! The straw poll conducted by the Riverview Chamber of Commerce shows me leading Democrat incumbent Kathy Castor by nearly five points. In the poll, we led by a margin of 52.63 percent to 47.37 percent.The poll accurately reflects other predicted similar poll results in two other Florida statewide races. It shows Sen. Marco Rubio (R-FL) leading Rep. Val Demmings (D-FL) in the state’s U.S. Senate race, with Rubio ahead by a margin of 51.28 percent to Demings’s 46.15 percent.The Riverview Chamber poll also shows Republican Laurel Lee handily beating her Democrat opponent in Florida’s 15th Congressional District, as expected. Kathy Castor Agrees to Debate Last week at a community forum in St. Petersburg, Castor verbally agreed to participate in a debate with me. She said she would be happy to debate anytime, however, so far Castor has not followed through with her promise.After telling our campaign to call her office to schedule the debate, her team has not returned our calls for a debate. I STILL NEED YOUR HELP! As the election environment continues to improve, and our chances of winning look more promising, please consider helping my campaign by making a contribution, volunteering or by placing a sign in your yard. We need money to get the word out. Please help today! | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2022 James Judge For Congress. All rights reserved.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad.

I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick.

That’s why I wrote this book. body:
The Left is desperate to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, so they came up with an “October Surprise.” We cannot let the Le |
---
Fellow American,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Fellow American, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=619135e3a4624128b21cf1d54c9ee8da&_e=aJN1m5jnmewvPrsEpT3t3RAWRQcORQVrZlyRiBOpXLPgHYLfyw2QGMMWQkJGoNJDQz9PgX5N142cYehhnrOXKCmZAbHJ2PEYez0ArHDxBEQ6ufCOMyqoLcVwPTj6BwO4cMnuBwZ2vW-dh8knhRgBjdUuHqLUy-DbSW9l_f6AWV69vLUt3_VTD-NT_U5WjlcHnrIMN28pepGNRYEOTMM9f7JRGGlqeEEMIp3ZAEhJH6spLKV0OknsYYyGz1LwaPr6ZUQ7Z8FkHT0OYpU-VObFE7WKnxjbzpNymYl00PmmXbqGdLm_434cbRepEam9DpQHS1cpTiFGmQo2ejfD5pTqhym-33-pcfzkFG8A3dowz-B7YVLnJQRyybiByV62nzbztxFieass1hB7aKGZE3HGNQ%3D%3D) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

Unfortunately, that's politics these days. I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder , with the goal of helping others. This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles. But their ads didn't work. The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race. In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie. We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth. Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me. First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court. Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family. Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

Please take a look: | Peter, For nearly 15 years and throughout this Senate campaign, I've been forthcoming about the mental health challenges that I struggled with in the past. I have overcome a lot in my life - self-confidence issues, a stutter, and thanks to the help of mental health professionals, dissociative personality disorder. I even wrote a book in 2008, called Breaking Free , about the trials I have faced in my life. On top of my efforts to be transparent with mental health issues, I regularly encourage those facing mental health challenges themselves - including our troops and veterans - to seek the help they need to overcome them. But apparently my efforts to get treatment, make amends, and help others with similar struggles is not enough in the eyes of Raphael Warnock, who has run millions in false and misleading attack ads to tear me down. We've launched a rebuttal ad to his nasty, dishonest campaign that helps set the record straight, I'm a Christian who is saved by grace. body:
“Nathan has been a pillar of our community in Los Angeles throughout his career— protecting our neighborhoods as a prosecutor..." | | |
---
| | | “Nathan has been a pillar of our community in Los Angeles throughout his career— protecting our neighborhoods as a prosecutor, faithfully upholding the rule of law in private practice, and giving back as a charitable and civic leader. We face severe challenges related to crime, homelessness, and drug abuse here in Los Angeles County, but I am confident that as Attorney General, Nathan will be the advocate we need to turn things around and restore public safety. I am proud to endorse Nathan Hochman for Attorney General.” **-Los Angeles County Supervisor Kathryn Barger**
---
| Thank you for the support, Supervisor Barger!

Kathryn Barger has been a pillar of common-sense and integrity in Los Angeles County. She has been outspoken about the need to get criminals off our streets and bring balance back to our justice system.

As a member of the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors, Supervisor Barger oversees a multi-billion dollar budget -- larger than the budgets of Kansas, Montana and Vermont combined -- making her one of the most powerful women in California.

I am so proud and honored to have her support in my campaign for Attorney General.
---
|
---
| Supervisor Barger's endorsement adds to the long list of public safety officials, elected leaders, and community organizations who have joined our cause of restoring safety and security in California.

In Los Angeles County alone, we have received the support of the Association of Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs and the Los Angeles Association of Deputy District Attorneys, representing thousands of hardworking law enforcement officials across the largest county in the United States.

Our coalition grows everyday, as more and more Californians realize that we will never change the poor decisions being made, if we don't change the people who are making them.

I am offering California a new bold vision for balanced criminal justice, and our message is resonating.

Thank you for your ongoing support.

Best,

Nathan Hochman
_Candidate for California Attorney General_

Peter, there’s a question on the lips of political pundits
across the country -- it’s this:
